Title: Forward Deployed AI Scientist, Italy - BCG X
Description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

We Are BCG X

We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game-changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions.

What You'll Do

Our BCG X teams own the full analytics value-chain end to end: framing new business challenges, designing innovative algorithms, implementing, and deploying scalable solutions, and enabling colleagues and clients to fully embrace AI. Our product offerings span from fully custom-builds to industry specific leading edge AI software solutions.

Our Forward Deployed AI Scientist and Senior Forward Deployed AI Scientist are part of our rapidly growing team to apply data science methods and analytics to real-world business situations across industries to drive significant business impact. You'll have the chance to partner with clients in a variety of BCG regions and industries, and on key topics like climate change, enabling them to design, build, and deploy new and innovative solutions.

Additional responsibilities will include developing and delivering thought leadership in scientific communities and papers as well as leading conferences on behalf of BCG X. Successful candidates are intellectually curious builders who are biased toward action, creative, and communicative.

We Are Looking For Dedicated Individuals With a Passion For Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research And Redefining Organizations Into AI Led Innovative Companies. Successful Candidates Possess The Following


Comfortable in a client-facing role with the ambition to lead teams
Likes to distill complex results or processes into simple, clear visualizations
Explain sophisticated data science concepts in an understandable manner
Love building things and are comfortable working with modern development tools and writing code collaboratively (bonus points if you have a software development or DevOps experience)
Significant experience applying advanced analytics to a variety of business situations and a proven ability to synthesize complex data
Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques and their mathematical underpinnings, and can translate this into business implications for our clients
Have strong project management skills
Fluency in both Italian and English


#BCGXjob

Title: AI & Data intelligence Research Engineer
Description:
Per progetti innovativi in ambito Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence e Machine Learning, siamo alla ricerca di un/una AI & Data intelligence Research Engineer da inserire all’interno di team multidisciplinari impegnati nell’analisi e valorizzazione dei dati.

La risorsa si occuperà di elaborare, analizzare e interpretare grandi volumi di dati attraverso tecniche statistiche avanzate e modelli di Machine Learning, con l’obiettivo di estrarre insight utili e generare valore per il business e per i clienti.

Attività principali


Analizzare e processare dati strutturati e non strutturati provenienti da fonti eterogenee
Sviluppare modelli statistici e algoritmi di Machine Learning e Deep Learning
Identificare pattern, trend e opportunità attraverso tecniche avanzate di analisi dei dati
Realizzare dashboard e strumenti di visualizzazione a supporto dei processi decisionali
Collaborare con team tecnici e stakeholder di business per trasformare i requisiti in soluzioni data-driven
Contribuire a progetti di innovazione e ricerca applicata in ambito Data Science e Artificial Intelligence


Requisiti


PhD o Laurea Magistrale in Data Science, Ricerca Operativa, Ingegneria Informatica, Informatica o discipline affini
Ottima conoscenza del linguaggio di programmazione Python
Gradita conoscenza del linguaggio Java
Esperienza nell’utilizzo dei principali toolkit e librerie di Data Science e Machine Learning
Esperienza con framework di Deep Learning quali PyTorch e TensorFlow
Conoscenza delle principali architetture e tecniche di AI Generativa, inclusi Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) e Vector Database
Conoscenza dei database relazionali e del linguaggio SQL
Conoscenza dei principali strumenti di Data Visualization, tra cui Plotly.js, D3.js, ggplot, Tableau e QlikView
Solide competenze nell’analisi e interpretazione dei dati mediante tecniche statistiche e modelli predittivi
Passione per la Data Exploration, l’analisi dei dati e la realizzazione di modelli a supporto dei processi decisionali
Approccio quantitativo, spiccate capacità analitiche e orientamento al problem solving
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata

Contratto di assunzione a Tempo indeterminato con applicazione del CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria;

Title: Graduate data scientist
Description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Design and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks.
Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems.
Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company.
Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking.
Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends.


What we look for
Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.


Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Description:
CHI SIAMO

AGAP2 è un gruppo europeo di consulenza ingegneristica e operativa facente parte del Gruppo MoOngy. Presente in 14 Paesi europei con oltre 7.500 dipendenti, abbiamo aperto otto anni fa la nostra prima sede italiana a Milano. Grazie alla continua crescita, stiamo ampliando il nostro team con persone che condividano i nostri valori: Ambizione, Sorriso, Dinamismo e Voglia di mettersi in gioco.

Crediamo in una realtà in continua evoluzione, dove le relazioni umane sono sempre al primo posto.




Data Scientist / AI Engineer

Data Scientist / AI Engineer con 3+ anni di esperienza in Machine Learning, GenAI e ambito Financial Services, per opportunità in modalità full remote.




Modalità: Full remote

Settore: Financial services




1. Il tuo ruolo

Entrare in un team strategico nel settore Financial Services come punto di riferimento tecnico per il cliente.
Partecipare attivamente ai tavoli di lavoro e ai meeting di approfondimento, aiutando a tradurre le esigenze di business in soluzioni concrete.
Lavorare con autonomia e proattività, proponendo approcci tecnologici mirati senza bisogno di micro-management.
Collaborare fianco a fianco con i team interni (Data Engineering, MLOps, Product) e con gli stakeholder aziendali.




2. Le tue mansioni

Sviluppare e implementare use case tipici del settore FSI: modelli di scoring, anomaly detection e NLP su documenti finanziari.
Progettare pipeline RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) per applicazioni basate su LLM, gestendo vector store (FAISS, Chroma, Pinecone), embedding e framework come LangChain o LlamaIndex.
Curare l'intero ciclo di vita dei modelli, occupandoti di industrializzazione, deployment e monitoraggio in produzione.
Supportare, quando necessario, le fasi di Pre-Sales e la creazione di demo tecniche.




3. I requisiti

Almeno 3 anni di esperienza nel ruolo di Data Scientist o AI Engineer (profilo Mid), preferibilmente in contesti strutturati e nel settore Financial Services.
Ottima padronanza di Python, SQL e familiarità con ambienti Big Data (Spark, Databricks) e Cloud (AWS e/o Azure).
Competenze pratiche di MLOps (versioning, CI/CD, monitoraggio dei modelli in produzione).
Ottime doti comunicative per spiegare concetti tecnici anche a interlocutori non tecnici e forte attitudine al problem solving.
Full remote reale: puoi lavorare comodamente da tutta Italia.







Cosa offriamo

RAL: 28.000 € – 43.000 €

La posizione è inquadrata secondo il CCNL Commercio e Terziario applicato dalla società.

L'inquadramento e la retribuzione saranno definiti sulla base di:

competenze tecniche;
esperienza maturata nel ruolo;
esito del processo di selezione;
secondo criteri oggettivi e neutri.

Per profili con caratteristiche particolarmente qualificate rispetto al range indicato, potrà essere valutata una revisione della proposta, previa approvazione interna.




The world needs you!

In AGAP2 crediamo che la diversità sia una fonte di valore e innovazione. Promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, nel quale ogni persona possa esprimere il proprio potenziale e contribuire con il proprio valore unico.

Valutiamo tutte le candidature senza distinzione di età, genere, nazionalità, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, religione o stato civile.

Prestiamo inoltre particolare attenzione alle candidature appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi degli artt. 1 e 18 della Legge 68/99.

I dati personali saranno trattati nel rispetto del Regolamento (UE) 2016/679 (GDPR).

  • Entrare in un team strategico nel settore Financial Services come punto di riferimento tecnico per il cliente.
  • Partecipare attivamente ai tavoli di lavoro e ai meeting di approfondimento, aiutando a tradurre le esigenze di business in soluzioni concrete.
  • Lavorare con autonomia e proattività, proponendo approcci tecnologici mirati senza bisogno di micro-management.
  • Collaborare fianco a fianco con i team interni (Data Engineering, MLOps, Product) e con gli stakeholder aziendali.


2. Le tue mansioni

  • Sviluppare e implementare use case tipici del settore FSI: modelli di scoring, anomaly detection e NLP su documenti finanziari.
  • Progettare pipeline RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) per applicazioni basate su LLM, gestendo vector store (FAISS, Chroma, Pinecone), embedding e framework come LangChain o LlamaIndex.
  • Curare l'intero ciclo di vita dei modelli, occupandoti di industrializzazione, deployment e monitoraggio in produzione.
  • Supportare, quando necessario, le fasi di Pre-Sales e la creazione di demo tecniche.


3. I requisiti

  • Almeno 3 anni di esperienza nel ruolo di Data Scientist o AI Engineer (profilo Mid), preferibilmente in contesti strutturati e nel settore Financial Services.
  • Ottima padronanza di Python, SQL e familiarità con ambienti Big Data (Spark, Databricks) e Cloud (AWS e/o Azure).
  • Competenze pratiche di MLOps (versioning, CI/CD, monitoraggio dei modelli in produzione).
  • Ottime doti comunicative per spiegare concetti tecnici anche a interlocutori non tecnici e forte attitudine al problem solving.
  • Full remote reale: puoi lavorare comodamente da tutta Italia.



Cosa offriamo

RAL: 28.000 € – 43.000 €

La posizione è inquadrata secondo il CCNL Commercio e Terziario applicato dalla società.

L'inquadramento e la retribuzione saranno definiti sulla base di:

  • competenze tecniche;
  • esperienza maturata nel ruolo;
  • esito del processo di selezione;
  • secondo criteri oggettivi e neutri.

Per profili con caratteristiche particolarmente qualificate rispetto al range indicato, potrà essere valutata una revisione della proposta, previa approvazione interna.


The world needs you!

In AGAP2 crediamo che la diversità sia una fonte di valore e innovazione. Promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, nel quale ogni persona possa esprimere il proprio potenziale e contribuire con il proprio valore unico.

Valutiamo tutte le candidature senza distinzione di età, genere, nazionalità, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, religione o stato civile.

Prestiamo inoltre particolare attenzione alle candidature appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi degli artt. 1 e 18 della Legge 68/99.

I dati personali saranno trattati nel rispetto del Regolamento (UE) 2016/679 (GDPR).

Title: Data scientist
Description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Design and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks.
Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems.
Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company.
Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking.
Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends.


What we look for
Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.


Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Title: Pricing Actuary/Data Analyst
Description:
Job Purpose/Role

The candidate would be required to provide support to the Non Motor Actuarial Office across the full spectrum of Pricing analysis.

The Individual's Key Responsibilities Are Listed Below


Support the data ingestion and data transformation procedures
Data exploration, transformation and cleaning procedures
Structuring data science solutions to achieve a given set of business objectives
Build and prototype analysis and Machine Learning models and support their implementation and deployment in the systems of the company
Model customer’s behavior based on market and competitor’s analysis
Implement and enhance dashboards and business intelligence tools to support risk analysis and portfolio management
Implementation of Radar Base Projects for Impact Analysis/Scenario Testing
Implementation of the tariff (both Technical and Commercial), discount, UW rules, renewal process in Radar Live in accordance with technical specification provided by Pricing Actuaries, Product Development and Anti-Fraud people
Doing Research and Development to find new technical solutions


Key Requirements/Skills/Experience


PhD or Master’s degree in a quantitative field (i.e. computer science, mathematics, physics, statistics or engineering)
2-3 years working experience in a similar role
Good hands-on knowledge of programming languages (e.g. Python, SAS or R)
Experience with Pandas or SQL for data manipulation and analysis
Familiarity with machine learning techniques like gradient boosting machines and linear models
Passion and ability for data exploration, analysis and modelling in order to design and develop systems to support strategic business decisions
Preferably knowledge of the Tower Watson Suite: Emblem, Radar
Fluent in Italian and English
Ability to work independently as well as engage and interact with different stakeholders


Pursuant to Article 5(1) of Legislative Decree No. 96 of 7 May 2026, as amended and supplemented from time to time, the range applicable to the position offered is between € 36.862,46 gross and € 45.000,00 gross. Employment will be subject to the terms and conditions set forth in the National Collective Labor Agreement for Insurance Companies and the applicable Company Agreement. The final determination of the starting remuneration will be based on an evaluation of the candidate's qualifications, skills, and relevant experience in relation to the requirements of the role.

We are united by a shared commitment: to put our customers first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.

Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future – for our customers and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Both genders may apply in accordance with the L. 903/77 (s.m.i).

Title: Risk Analytics & Data Science Senior Consultant - Risk Consulting
Description:
Risk Analytics & Data Science Senior Consultant – Risk Consulting

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Se cerchi un percorso di crescita in un contesto internazionale dove le tue idee contano davvero, sei nel posto giusto. In un contesto in cui l'intelligenza artificiale sta ridefinendo il modo di lavorare, crediamo che il vero valore nasca dalla capacità delle persone di interpretare la complessità, costruire relazioni di fiducia e trasformare le opportunità tecnologiche in impatto concreto per clienti, organizzazioni e società.

Perché candidarsi in EY?

Lo abbiamo chiesto a chi ci lavora già! Questi i fattori più influenti:


Investimento sulle competenze del futuro: In EY la tecnologia non sostituisce il contributo delle persone: lo amplifica. Per questo investiamo nello sviluppo di competenze, relazioni e capacità di giudizio che permettono di affrontare le sfide più complesse e generare valore sostenibile nel tempo. Fin dal primo giorno, avrai accesso a eventi, strumenti e corsi sull’Intelligenza Artificiale, per imparare a usare la tecnologia come leva per amplificare il tuo impatto.
Formazione continua: oltre 50 ore di corsi tecnici e manageriali all’anno previsti per ciascuna persona; per integrare apprendimento e lavoro quotidiano, trasformando ogni progetto in un’occasione di crescita.
Sviluppo e progressione di carriera: solo negli ultimi 12 mesi, oltre la metà delle persone di EY si è vista riconoscere un avanzamento di carriera; con percorsi in cui competenze, potenziale e contributo individuale diventano elementi centrali.
Mobilità e opportunità internazionali, compresa la possibilità di lavorare in smart working dall’estero fino a 20 giorni senza essere in trasferta;
Lavoro ibrido senza giornate prestabilite centralmente.
Un network internazionale su cui poter contare.


Vuoi dare forma al tuo futuro insieme a noi?

Scopri nel concreto che cosa fa un/una Risk Analytics & Data Science Senior Consultant!

Siamo alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire in un team specializzato lato Enterprise Risk, con competenze verticali su Business Intelligence, Data Science e Risk Analytics, ed esperienza nell'applicazione di metodologie analitiche avanzate per supportare il monitoraggio e la gestione dei rischi aziendali. La figura sarà coinvolta nella progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni data-driven a supporto dei processi decisionali, combinando competenze quantitative, capacità di analisi e conoscenza dei principali framework di Risk & Compliance Management.

Nello specifico, ti occuperai di:


definizione, monitoraggio e gestione di KPI e Key Risk Indicators (KRI) evoluti;
sviluppo di indicatori predittivi ed Early Warning Systems per il monitoraggio continuo dei rischi;
costruzione di modelli di scoring, classificazione e valutazione del rischio.
realizzazione di dashboard direzionali e strumenti di Business Intelligence a supporto delle decisioni manageriali;
sviluppo di modelli analitici avanzati basati su tecniche statistiche, Machine Learning e Predictive Analytics;
analisi delle relazioni tra rischi mediante approcci di Risk Network Analysis e Graph Analytics;
collaborazione con stakeholder business, Risk e Compliance per tradurre esigenze operative in modelli quantitativi e strumenti analitici;
sviluppo e manutenzione di data pipeline e processi automatizzati per l'elaborazione e l'analisi dei dati;


Per cominciare, cerchiamo un professionista senior che abbia le seguenti competenze tecniche e personali:


esperienza di 2/3 anni nella progettazione di dashboard executive, nello sviluppo di modelli predittivi, forecasting, anomaly detection e sistemi decisionali data-driven.
buone conoscenze lato BI & Data Visualization, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics e modelli probabilistici; ottima conoscenza di Python e SQL
capacità di tradurre esigenze di Risk e Compliance Management in modelli quantitativi e strumenti operativi fruibili dal business.
costituiscono titolo preferenziale esperienze con piattaforme SAS o ambienti di sviluppo analitico avanzati similari.
costituiscono titolo preferenziale esperienze con strumenti ETL quali IBM DataStage, Informatica o soluzioni equivalenti per la realizzazione di data pipeline automatizzate.
costituiscono titolo preferenziale esperienze maturate in contesti di Risk Management, Fraud Management, Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) o AI Governance.


In EY potrai:


Accelerare le tue competenze: grazie a programmi di sviluppo orientati al futuro e a strumenti AI che automatizzano attività ripetitive, potrai dedicare più tempo all'analisi, alla consulenza, all'innovazione e alla costruzione di relazioni professionali ad alto impatto.
Allargare i tuoi orizzonti: lavora in team internazionali e multidisciplinari, confrontandoti con prospettive diverse e contribuendo a sviluppare soluzioni che combinano tecnologia, competenze specialistiche e intuizione umana.
Dare il meglio di te: Investi costantemente nel tuo benessere personale e nello sviluppo della tua carriera, con una figura di Counselor che ti supporta dal primo giorno.


Avrai infine l’opportunità di:


accedere a benefits e programmi di welfare aziendale diversificati;
partecipare a programmi di leadership.


Per la presente posizione è previsto un range retributivo compreso tra 33.000€ e 44.000€, definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. Il rapporto di lavoro è regolato dal CCNL Commercio; il livello di inquadramento contrattuale e collettivo e la relativa disciplina applicabile saranno determinati in coerenza con l’esperienza e il profilo professionale della risorsa inserita nel processo di selezione. Per la specifica posizione è previsto un bonus al raggiungimento di obiettivi preventivamente comunicati e concordati.

In EY crediamo che ciascuna persona porti con sé qualcosa di unico: le tue esperienze, ambizioni e prospettive contribuiscono a creare un ambiente in cui l’unicità di ognuno diventa la nostra forza collettiva.

Promuoviamo una cultura inclusiva, dove tutte le voci sono ascoltate e valorizzate: Together, all in. Valorizziamo ogni forma di unicità — età, genere, abilità, esperienza, cultura, orientamento sessuale, religione, disabilità e background socioeconomico — e assicuriamo che tutte le nostre offerte siano aperte anche a persone con disabilità, in linea con la legge italiana L.68/99.

Per offrirti la migliore esperienza possibile nel processo di selezione, ti invitiamo a segnalarci eventuali esigenze o supporti di cui potresti avere bisogno.

EY | La nostra missione? Building a better working world

In EY ci occupiamo di consulenza direzionale, strategica, legale, tributaria, tecnologica, organizzativa e di revisione contabile. Lo facciamo attraverso un network mondiale di servizi professionali presente in oltre 150 Paesi in tutto il mondo. In Italia siamo un Team di oltre 9.000 persone, distribuite in 20 città in tutta Italia. Crediamo fortemente nella creazione di valore a lungo termine, attraverso una crescita economica che sia inclusiva e sostenibile per tutti, dai colleghi ai clienti, dall'ambiente alla società.

Siamo alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire in un team specializzato lato Enterprise Risk, con competenze verticali su Business Intelligence, Data Science e Risk Analytics, ed esperienza nell'applicazione di metodologie analitiche avanzate per supportare il monitoraggio e la gestione dei rischi aziendali. La figura sarà coinvolta nella progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni data-driven a supporto dei processi decisionali, combinando competenze quantitative, capacità di analisi e conoscenza dei principali framework di Risk & Compliance Management.

Nello specifico, ti occuperai di:

  • definizione, monitoraggio e gestione di KPI e Key Risk Indicators (KRI) evoluti;
  • sviluppo di indicatori predittivi ed Early Warning Systems per il monitoraggio continuo dei rischi;
  • costruzione di modelli di scoring, classificazione e valutazione del rischio.
  • realizzazione di dashboard direzionali e strumenti di Business Intelligence a supporto delle decisioni manageriali;
  • sviluppo di modelli analitici avanzati basati su tecniche statistiche, Machine Learning e Predictive Analytics;
  • analisi delle relazioni tra rischi mediante approcci di Risk Network Analysis e Graph Analytics;
  • collaborazione con stakeholder business, Risk e Compliance per tradurre esigenze operative in modelli quantitativi e strumenti analitici;
  • sviluppo e manutenzione di data pipeline e processi automatizzati per l'elaborazione e l'analisi dei dati;

Per cominciare, cerchiamo un professionista senior che abbia le seguenti competenze tecniche e personali:

  • esperienza di 2/3 anni nella progettazione di dashboard executive, nello sviluppo di modelli predittivi, forecasting, anomaly detection e sistemi decisionali data-driven.
  • buone conoscenze lato BI & Data Visualization, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics e modelli probabilistici; ottima conoscenza di Python e SQL
  • capacità di tradurre esigenze di Risk e Compliance Management in modelli quantitativi e strumenti operativi fruibili dal business.
  • costituiscono titolo preferenziale esperienze con piattaforme SAS o ambienti di sviluppo analitico avanzati similari.
  • costituiscono titolo preferenziale esperienze con strumenti ETL quali IBM DataStage, Informatica o soluzioni equivalenti per la realizzazione di data pipeline automatizzate.
  • costituiscono titolo preferenziale esperienze maturate in contesti di Risk Management, Fraud Management, Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) o AI Governance.

In EY potrai:

  • Accelerare le tue competenze: grazie a programmi di sviluppo orientati al futuro e a strumenti AI che automatizzano attività ripetitive, potrai dedicare più tempo all'analisi, alla consulenza, all'innovazione e alla costruzione di relazioni professionali ad alto impatto.
  • Allargare i tuoi orizzonti: lavora in team internazionali e multidisciplinari, confrontandoti con prospettive diverse e contribuendo a sviluppare soluzioni che combinano tecnologia, competenze specialistiche e intuizione umana.
  • Dare il meglio di te: Investi costantemente nel tuo benessere personale e nello sviluppo della tua carriera, con una figura di Counselor che ti supporta dal primo giorno.

Avrai infine l’opportunità di:

  • accedere a benefits e programmi di welfare aziendale diversificati;
  • partecipare a programmi di leadership.

Per la presente posizione è previsto un range retributivo compreso tra 33.000€ e 44.000€, definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. Il rapporto di lavoro è regolato dal CCNL Commercio; il livello di inquadramento contrattuale e collettivo e la relativa disciplina applicabile saranno determinati in coerenza con l’esperienza e il profilo professionale della risorsa inserita nel processo di selezione. Per la specifica posizione è previsto un bonus al raggiungimento di obiettivi preventivamente comunicati e concordati.

In EY crediamo che ciascuna persona porti con sé qualcosa di unico: le tue esperienze, ambizioni e prospettive contribuiscono a creare un ambiente in cui l’unicità di ognuno diventa la nostra forza collettiva.

Promuoviamo una cultura inclusiva, dove tutte le voci sono ascoltate e valorizzate: Together, all in. Valorizziamo ogni forma di unicità — età, genere, abilità, esperienza, cultura, orientamento sessuale, religione, disabilità e background socioeconomico — e assicuriamo che tutte le nostre offerte siano aperte anche a persone con disabilità, in linea con la legge italiana L.68/99.

Per offrirti la migliore esperienza possibile nel processo di selezione, ti invitiamo a segnalarci eventuali esigenze o supporti di cui potresti avere bisogno.

EY | La nostra missione? Building a better working world

In EY ci occupiamo di consulenza direzionale, strategica, legale, tributaria, tecnologica, organizzativa e di revisione contabile. Lo facciamo attraverso un network mondiale di servizi professionali presente in oltre 150 Paesi in tutto il mondo. In Italia siamo un Team di oltre 9.000 persone, distribuite in 20 città in tutta Italia. Crediamo fortemente nella creazione di valore a lungo termine, attraverso una crescita economica che sia inclusiva e sostenibile per tutti, dai colleghi ai clienti, dall'ambiente alla società.

Title: Data Science Generative AI Consultant
Description:
In Accenture, potrai portare la tua visione innovativa per reinventare interi settori di mercato, lavorando con le aziende più importanti a livello mondiale. Modella il futuro del business e della tecnologia sviluppando soluzioni all'avanguardia in grado di generare nuovo valore.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue prospettive

Entra a far parte del nostro network internazionale di talenti nel Reinvention Partner Industry & Enterprise in ambito AI and Data, all’interno del Centro di Eccellenza Advanced AI. Lavorerai con tecnologie innovative su progetti entusiasmanti, aiutando le aziende leader a livello mondiale a sviluppare le loro strategie IT. In particolare, potrai:



Analizzare i requisiti di business dei clienti e tradurli in soluzioni algoritmiche;

Sviluppare codice in Python utilizzando librerie e framework per la manipolazione e analisi dei dati;

Contribuire allo sviluppo di soluzioni basate prevalentemente su Generative AI e Large Language Models;

Gestire il ciclo di vita delle soluzioni dalla gestione e trasformazione dati tramite pipeline di ETL, sviluppo e validazione modelli (tramite definizione di test set, sfruttando librerie quali deepeval, ragas, quando possibile o codice custom) fino al deploy e monitoraggio in produzione su cloud a seconda dell’ambiente cliente;

Garantire qualità dei dati in ingresso e performance delle soluzioni sviluppate.



La retribuzione prevista in Accenture viene definita sulla base di molteplici elementi di valutazione, tra cui – ad esempio - il ruolo ricoperto, il livello di seniority, il grado di responsabilità, le competenze professionali e l’esperienza maturata. Per la presente posizione, è previsto un livello di inquadramento B3 nel CCNL Metalmeccanico

La fascia di retribuzione annua lorda prevista è compresa tra 36.906,87€ e 46.700€.

Se condividi la nostra passione per la consulenza in ambito Data & AI e hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando

Basic Qualifications



Esperienza professionale:

da 2 a 5 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di implementazione di soluzioni AI;

Esperienza in modellazione e trasformazione del dato, strutture dati, sistemi di storage e partizionamento




Formazione:

Laurea magistrale conclusa in area STEM (Informatica, Ingegneria, Matematica, Fisica, Bioingegneria o simili).




Competenze tecniche:

Esperienza nello sviluppo in Python per analisi e manipolazione dati (es. Pandas, Polars, NumPy, Matplotlib);

Esperienza con tecniche di Machine Learning e Deep Learning;

Esperienza nell’utilizzo di Large Language Models;

Propensione all’uso di Coding Agents (e.g. Claude Code, Github Copilot, Codex).




Versioning e strumenti base:

Esperienza nell’utilizzo di strumenti di versioning del codice (Git);

Esperienza nell’utilizzo di database relazionali (SQL);

Esperienza almeno basilare di strumenti di containerizzazione (Docker). ️




Lingue:

Conoscenza della lingua italiana e inglese, sia scritta che parlata, livello C1 o Madrelingua

Title: AI & Data Science Engineer
Description:
Job Description

DXC Technology is looking for a Data Scientist to support AI and Generative AI projects, contributing to practical solutions and improving business processes through ML models, NLP and intelligent automation, within the Data & AI team based in Milan.

Key Responsibilities


Contribute to the design and implementation of AI solutions, including machine learning models, NLP, and computer vision applications
Collaborate with senior team members to understand client requirements and translate them into practical AI solutions
Support the direct relationship with clients/stakeholders for requirements gathering and solution validation
Support pre-sales activities, including preparing technical materials and contributing to client presentations
Stay up to date on AI trends and emerging technologies, applying knowledge to support solution development
Contribute to maintaining best practices and methodologies within the AI & Data Science team
Take part in AI solution projects, gaining hands-on experience in real client environments and progressively growing in autonomy.


Requirements


Proven experience in Gen AI projects.
Ability to translate business requirements into practical AI solutions, including design and implementation.
Deep expertise in core Generative AI technologies, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Prompt Engineering, Observability, and AI Guardrails.
Extensive experience with enterprise-grade GenAI development frameworks and platforms, including LangChain, LangGraph, LiteLLM, and Langfuse.
Proven experience in addressing AI governance, GDPR, and EU AI Act compliance requirements throughout the AI solution lifecycle.
Good knowledge of machine learning frameworks and libraries (Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, etc.)
Strong proficiency in AI-powered software development and code generation tools.
Extensive experience with enterprise software delivery practices and platforms, including source code management, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment frameworks.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Good communication skills and strong ability to work in a collaborative team.
Growing autonomy in managing assigned tasks and deliverables.
Ability to organize project activities by identifying priorities and ensuring deadlines are met


Nice to Have


Previous involvement in presales or solution support tasks


Location: Milan, with smart working possibility

The position offers a gross annual base salary starting from €48.000

Title: Experienced – Data Scientist GenAI
Description:
Stiamo cercando una figura Senior Consultant da inserire nel team Digital, AI Controls & Algorithms per le sedi di Roma e Milano che lavorerà in modalità Hybrid.

L’area Digital, AI Controls & Algorithms è un’area di frontiera nell’utilizzo di tecnologie avanzate e si occupa di fornire servizi di Digital Transformation con l’obiettivo di supportare la digitalizzazione dei processi di business delle principali multinazionali clienti. Le attività prevedono l’utilizzo di strumenti di Generative AI, AI e Data Analytics, integrati all’interno di un ecosistema applicativo e infrastrutturale all’avanguardia (SOTA). Per questo, sfruttiamo i principali servizi offerti dai maggiori player del settore Cloud, oltre a soluzioni di deployment locali on-premise.

Your Role

La risorsa Experienced verrà inserita in un team di lavoro e si occuperà di:


Leadership Tecnologica: Assumere il ruolo di Team Leader, supervisionando e coordinando un team tecnico di sviluppo o consulenti junior con diverse expertise
Progettazione e Analisi Soluzioni AI & GenAI: Analizzare e progettare soluzioni GenAI, AI complesse, sia applicative che di integrazione con diversi sistemi
Gestione del Problem Solving: Affrontare e risolvere autonomamente problematiche tecniche articolate, mantenendo efficienza e precisione anche sotto pressione;
Collaborazione Internazionale: Operare all'interno di team numerosi e diversificati, con la possibilità di interagire su scala internazionale.


What We Offer

La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra EUR 33.000 e EUR 37.500 lordi annui per il grade Consultant, e tra EUR 40.000 e EUR 49.000 lordi annui per il grade Senior Consultant.

L'inquadramento verrà definito in fase di selezione sulla base del profilo e in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi.

La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.

Winning Requirements


Laurea in materie STEM;
Esperienza nella gestione end-to-end di progetti di Data Science: raccolta requisiti, progettazione, sviluppo e test di soluzioni AI e GenAI. In particolare è richiesta esperienza di almeno 5 anni nell’ambito dei progetti di AI/ML e 2 anni nell’ambito dei progetti di GenAI
Conoscenza dei principali foundation model (llama, gpt, sonnet etc.) e loro applicazione a seconda della specificità del progetto.
Esperienza pregressa nello sviluppo di applicazioni di Generative AI (langchain, llamaindex, ecc.) con sviluppo e rilascio in produzione di soluzioni RAG sia in modalità chatbot che non
Ottima conoscenza di Python e delle librerie per manipolazione dati e sviluppo modelli;
Esperienza con strumenti di containerizzazione (e.g. docker) e strumenti di versioning del codice (e.g. GIT)
Conoscenza di strumenti e linguaggi per la manipolazione dei dati: SQL, MongoDB, Neo4j, Spark, ecc.
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese;
Flessibilità, disponibilità a viaggiare.


To Make An Impact That Matters

Il network Deloitte, leader nei servizi professionali alle imprese, opera a livello globale in più di 150 Paesi con oltre 460 mila persone.

In Italia, Deloitte è presente in 24 città con circa 13.400 persone che assistono i clienti offrendo servizi di Audit & Assurance, Technology & Transformantion, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory e Tax & Legal.

In qualità di network globale ci impegniamo per affrontare le principali sfide sociali, economiche e ambientali della società di oggi. WorldImpact è il nostro programma globale che riunisce tutte le iniziative attraverso cui vogliamo avere un impatto positivo sulle persone, i clienti, l’ambiente e le comunità in cui operiamo.

Con Impact for Italy, la declinazione italiana di WorldImpact, Deloitte ha realizzato progetti che - in collaborazione con istituzioni, realtà del terzo settore, università e altri soggetti - hanno lasciato un impatto concreto e una legacy per il futuro su tutto il territorio nazionale.

La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006, il D.lgs. 215/03 e il D.lgs. 216/03 ed è aperta a candidat* di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività.

Title: AI Scientist
Description:
Build the science that shapes the future of human health.

Application closing date: 11.11.2026

Join a place where ambitious science thrives

Human Technopole (Milan) is a rapidly expanding life science institute where international researchers and cutting-edge technologies converge to accelerate biomedical discovery. Our mission is to transform bold scientific ideas into advances that improve human health.

Within this mission, the Casale Group in the Health Data Science Centre develops AI methods that transform population-scale human data into mechanistic models of disease. Our research integrates large-scale human genetics with molecular and clinical data to generate testable hypotheses that accelerate biological discovery and therapeutic innovation.

We are recruiting an ambitious AI Scientist to build the reusable AI foundations and agentic scientific systems that power the group’s research across human genetics, multimodal biology, and disease.

Your mission

As AI Scientist, you will develop next-generation AI systems at the interface of ambitious biological research and frontier artificial intelligence, using population-scale genetics and multimodal biomedical data to uncover mechanisms of human disease.

You will turn methods and models emerging from this research into robust, reusable AI capabilities—including foundation models, multimodal representation learning, agentic workflows, evaluation frameworks, and scalable research software—that can accelerate discovery across multiple projects.

A longer-term goal is to develop AI systems that increasingly act as scientific collaborators: connecting evidence across biological scales, proposing testable hypotheses, identifying informative analyses, and working alongside researchers to accelerate iterative cycles of biological discovery.

Your work will combine methodological innovation, biological discovery, and scientific software development at the intersection of artificial intelligence, computational biology, and human genetics. You will have substantial scientific and technical ownership, with the opportunity to help shape the group’s technical AI architecture while leading and contributing to high-impact scientific publications, open-source software, and reusable research capabilities.

As part of Human Technopole’s interdisciplinary AI ecosystem, you will engage closely with the European AI community, including through collaborations with Helmholtz Munich and connections to the ELLIS network. Your work will benefit from interactions with computational, biological, and clinical groups across the institute, alongside opportunities for international collaboration, research exchanges, interdisciplinary training, and engagement with industry.

You will also draw on the group’s established network across leading academic institutions and industry partners in Europe and North America, helping you build collaborations, broaden your expertise, and accelerate the impact of your research.

Grow Your Skills

You will enhance your scientific and professional skills by:


Developing next-generation AI methods through ambitious biological research.
Building foundation models, multimodal representation learning approaches, and agentic AI systems for scientific discovery.
Turning scientific advances into robust, benchmarked, and reusable AI capabilities that accelerate discovery across multiple research projects.
Building scalable research software and AI workflows for large and heterogeneous scientific datasets.
Shaping the future of AI for science through high-impact publications, open-source software, international collaborations, and entrepreneurial initiatives.


Human Technopole supports career development through training, mentoring and dedicated learning opportunities.

Essential

What you'll bring


PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Computational Biology, or a related quantitative discipline, or expected completion within the next six months.
At least 4 years of relevant research experience by the start of the position, including doctoral research.
Strong track record of scientific output in AI, machine learning, computational biology, or biomedicine, demonstrating independent methodological or technical contributions through publications, open-source software, models, or comparable research outputs.
Excellent programming and software engineering skills in Python, with experience building scalable and maintainable research software, model-training workflows, or AI systems.
Strong expertise in modern machine learning and AI, with demonstrated ability to design, develop, and critically evaluate advanced methods for challenging research problems.
Experience with modern software engineering and computational research practices, including version control, testing, documentation, reproducibility, and large-scale GPU or HPC environments.


Preferred


Industry or applied R&D experience in roles such as AI/ML architect, research scientist, machine learning scientist, or equivalent positions with substantial technical ownership.
Experience developing foundation models or other large-scale AI systems for scientific or biomedical applications.
Experience developing or applying LLM-based agents and agentic workflows for scientific or technical tasks, including analysis, information integration, automation, or hypothesis generation.
Experience integrating multimodal biomedical datasets, including molecular, imaging, clinical, or population-scale data.
Experience leading collaborative software projects and contributing to open-source scientific software or models.
Experience with workflow management, containerisation, and scalable GPU/HPC computing.
Familiarity with human genetics and computational biology is advantageous but not required.
Experience applying AI within drug discovery, translational research, or related biomedical pipelines is an advantage.


Organizational and social skills


Strong analytical thinking and scientific curiosity.
Ability to work independently while thriving in an interdisciplinary and collaborative environment.
Excellent communication and scientific writing skills.
Creativity, intellectual humility, and enthusiasm for tackling challenging biological questions.
Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to take ownership of ambitious research projects.


At HT, your discoveries contribute to a global effort to improve human health.

Why Human Technopole

HT offers an international and dynamic workplace, competitive welfare provisions, flexible working policies and relocation support. Candidates moving to Italy may benefit from attractive tax benefits. We promote work–life balance and provide parental support initiatives.

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
Company Description

Moviri started as a research spinoff at Politecnico of Milan and was incubated at its startup accelerator.

Data and experimentation are part of our DNA: it is for this reason that we continuously focus on research, emerging ideas, and new technologies, routinely partnering with top academic and engineering research institutions.

Moviri Consulting is the first company of Moviri and its foundation. Moviri’s professionals use data, software, and insights to solve substantial business challenges for Fortune 500 corporations, multinational banks, global media conglomerates and some of the most respected brands in a variety of industries. The Moviri Consulting Performance Engineering team optimizes performance of IT systems to make them responsive, infinitely scalable, reliable, resilient and cost-effective.




What you'll do

As part of our AI Labs team, you'll contribute to projects ranging from traditional Machine Learning to the latest Generative AI applications.




Your responsibilities will include:

Designing and developing solutions based on Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI.
Building data pipelines for data collection, processing, and validation across multiple sources.
Developing, training, and optimizing advanced models for real-world use cases.
Deploying AI models and applications into production environments, ensuring reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to transform business challenges into impactful technology solutions.
Exploring new frameworks, tools, and methodologies while contributing to the continuous evolution of the team’s capabilities.
Working with cutting-edge technologies in Generative AI, Natural Language Processing, and Advanced Analytics.




Who we're looking for

We are seeking a curious, proactive employee with a genuine passion for technology.




Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, or a related STEM field.
Experience in software development and programming using Python, Java, C++, R, or similar languages.
Familiarity with Data Science and Machine Learning frameworks such as Pandas, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Keras, Matplotlib, and FastAPI.
Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases.
Familiarity with Git, Agile methodologies, and CI/CD practices.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Knowledge of Big Data ecosystems, including Spark and Hadoop.
Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
Interest in or experience with Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, and Generative AI solutions.




Why Moviri is your place

Moviri is where you can truly grow, challenge yourself, and make an impact.




Work on meaningful projects: you'll contribute to innovative initiatives for leading international organizations, applying AI to real-world challenges with measurable impact.




Grow fast: we invest in our people. You'll learn from experienced professionals, work with emerging technologies, and continuously develop both technical and consulting skills.




Flexibility and trust: we believe autonomy and accountability go hand in hand. We offer a hybrid working model and empower our people to take ownership of their work and make an impact.




Tech Your Way: great ideas come from people who have the right tools to bring them to life. Whether you're a Mac or Windows enthusiast, you'll be free to choose the setup that best supports the way you create, build, and innovate.




Rewards & Benefits: we offer a competitive compensation package, with a salary range between €27,000 and €32,000 depending on experience and qualifications, along with Satispay meal vouchers and a yearly welfare allowance of €600. As part of the overall compensation package, employees may also be eligible for an annual performance-based bonus (MBO), reflecting both individual contribution and company performance.




Fresh Ideas, Fresh Fruit: Well-being matters too. That's why, through our partnership with Cortilia, we provide fresh fruit in the office every week, supporting healthy habits and a more sustainable workplace.




We also believe that great workplaces are built through shared experiences. Throughout the year, we organize team-building activities, company events, and informal gatherings (Beer Friday, Company Parties...) creating opportunities to connect, collaborate, and celebrate together.




Location: Milan or Padua (Italy), with a hybrid working model.




The selection process

We're looking for people who can grow and make a meaningful impact over time. That's why our selection process is designed to assess not only technical skills, but also potential, curiosity, and problem-solving ability.




The process may include multiple stages, such as technical interviews and discussions with team members. Every application is reviewed carefully, and we strive to provide a transparent and respectful experience for all candidates.




Technology evolves constantly, and nobody knows everything. What matters most is the willingness to learn, challenge yourself, and contribute with curiosity, accountability, and a collaborative mindset.




Join us

If you'd like to work on cutting-edge AI projects, grow in a collaborative environment, and help build innovative solutions used in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Advisory Analytics Manager - EMEA
Description:
Advisory Analytics Manager – EMEA

Aon exists to build decisions for the better — safeguarding and enriching the lives of people around the world. Our colleagues provide our clients in over 120 countries with advice and solutions that give them the clearness and confidence to make better decisions to protect and grow their business.

Our Analytics Team helps organisations make better workforce decisions by applying quantitative methods, statistical analysis, and sophisticated people analytics across human capital, compensation, and talent topics. Part of our work is supporting clients on compensation fairness, clearness in remuneration, and reward equity. We also help HR professionals and business leaders understand broader workforce dynamics and link talent outcomes to business performance.

Our division is a fast-growing area of advisory work: we combine Aon’s proprietary datasets with client data to answer strategic questions using meticulous analytical techniques, including pay equity modelling, segmentation, benchmarking, predictive modelling, driver analysis, and workforce diagnostics related to reward, talent acquisition, deployment, retention, workforce planning, and business performance.

Core Responsibilities


Interrogate large, sophisticated, and often imperfect client and proprietary datasets to identify workforce, reward, and talent patterns, including potential pay equity issues, data anomalies, and opportunities for evidence-based insight.
Lead or run elaborate analytics engagements from problem definition and data specification through data preparation, methodology selection, model development, validation, and interpretation of results across topics such as pay equity, pay transparency, workforce planning, reward analytics, and predictive people analytics.
Synthesise sophisticated quantitative outputs into clear narratives, translating statistical findings, pay equity diagnostics, model results, and benchmark comparisons into practical implications and recommendations for HR and organizational decision-makers.
Build analytically robust solutions to client issues by defining the data strategy, analytical framework, control factors where relevant, modelling approach, and required outputs, while balancing technical depth with commercial feasibility.
Demonstrate commercial leadership by understanding and interpreting client requirements related to compensation fairness, incentives, employee base, and people analytics. Craft these problems into compelling client proposals.


Qualifications And Experience That Will Lead To Success

As an Analytics Manager, your skills and experience will ideally include:


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Mathematics; postgraduate training in analytics is profitable.
Experience with statistical methods and analytical techniques, such as regression analysis, hypothesis testing, segmentation, trend analysis.
Hands-on experience working with large and complicated HR, reward, compensation, and workforce datasets, ideally using Python, R, SQL, or analogous tools for data manipulation, analysis, and quality assurance.
Significant experience delivering analytical work in consulting and/or corporate analytics environments, ideally in pay equity, compensation, workforce, HR, or people analytics, with exposure to sophisticated client datasets and multi-country contexts.
Strong capability in data visualisation, dashboarding, and insight communication, including tools such as Tableau or Power BI, demonstrating skill in distilling pay equity, reward, and workforce analyses into clear and decision-useful outputs.
A meticulous and curious analytical mind, with strong attention to detail, good judgement on data limitations, and a proactive approach to solving technically and commercially intricate problems.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical methods, findings, and limitations clearly to non-technical interested parties and senior audiences.


The expected salary for the role is within an indicative range of €46,300.00 - €69,500.00, based

on the candidate's experience and seniority.

L’area “Innovation Drive”, in cui sarà inserita la risorsa, è il Centro di Eccellenza di CRIF che combina le migliori competenze di Data Science, GenAI e Data Engineering. Siamo un gruppo eclettico ed in rapida crescita, composto da giovani che collaborano in un ambiente internazionale sereno, fortemente orientato all’innovazione e attento alla crescita delle persone che vi lavorano, con il giusto mix di interazione fisica e collaborazione da remoto.




La figura si occuperà di:

progettare, sviluppare e manutenere sistemi di AI e GenAI avanzati, sia in ambito Machine Learning sia LLM‑based
contribuire alla definizione e all’evoluzione di architetture production‑grade per modelli ML/LLM e sistemi agentici
lavorare su post‑training e valutazione di Large Language Models (es. fine‑tuning supervisionato, reinforcement learning, distillazione)
sviluppare e ottimizzare embedding models e soluzioni basate su RAG e vector database
partecipare a progetti complessi con clienti interni ed esterni, collaborando con Data Scientist, Data Engineer, Cloud Engineer e stakeholder di business
contribuire a prototipi, acceleratori e nuovi prodotti AI / GenAI, portandoli dalla sperimentazione alla produzione
supportare l’evoluzione delle best practice di MLOps, LLMOps e microservizi




Principali requisiti:

Laurea magistrale o PhD in ambiti quantitativi (Statistica, Matematica Applicata, Informatica, Data Science, Economia Quantitativa o affini)
2+ anni di esperienza lavorativa come AI Engineer
forte attitudine al problem solving, autonomia operativa e capacità di lavorare in team multidisciplinari
ottime capacità comunicative e di sintesi, sia tecniche sia di business
interesse costante verso i principali trend e le tecnologie emergenti in ambito AI e Generative AI




Hard skills:

eccellente padronanza di Python e delle principali librerie ML/DL
solida conoscenza di statistica, machine learning e modellistica predittiva (validazione, inferenza, classificazione, regressione, ecc.)
esperienza sui processi di post‑training e valutazione dei LLM (SFT, RL, distillazione)
conoscenza approfondita di embedding models (bi‑encoder, cross‑encoder) e delle tecniche di fine‑tuning
esperienza con architetture agentiche e protocolli / design pattern per AI Agent
utilizzo di synthetic data per test, validazione e valutazione di sistemi AI
familiarità con vector database (es. Pinecone, Qdrant) e soluzioni RAG
esperienza con cloud provider (AWS, GCP o Azure)
conoscenza di MLOps e architetture a microservizi
buona padronanza della lingua inglese (livello minimo B1/B2)




Nice to Have (requisiti che, se posseduti, sono considerati un plus):

Title: Advanced Analytics Project Leader
Description:
The Group Advanced analytics and Automation Solutions Unit is in charge of driving the identification and execution of key Advanced Analytics projects at Group level, related both to AI-driven automation and AI recommendations/predictions, and support local BUs, where needed, to implement local projects; the unit is also responsible for designing, implementing and continuously improving the library of central shared analytics / automation services available for the BUs through a central platform.




Advanced Analytics Project Leader, in charge of identifying, designing, developing and managing, in collaboration with the various business structures, artificial intelligence solutions that data analytics aim to provide recommendations / predictions to be used by different stakeholders, such as anti-fraud models or price elasticity models.




Main tasks and responsibilities:

You will drive the project set-up, the analysis of the as-is process / situation, the creation of a business case, the design of the target solution and its continuous improvement based on the results obtained during the testing phase
You will be responsible for the implementation of the end-to-end initiatives, including priorities definition, budget management, management of internal and external service providers and business interfaces and ensuring buy-in and execution
In particular, you will coordinate the development of the solution both from a logical point of view, you will lead the Data Scientists in the technical execution of all the analytical components - including Machine Learning models - and you will ensure their deployment with the support of Automation Engineers and IT Architects
You will have the opportunity to have regular and frequent interactions with the business functions, who from time to time will be involved in the various projects, as well as with the management.




Requirements

5+ years as Data Scientist in a consulting firm or in a company
1-2 years experience in managing projects related to artificial intelligence, digital transformation or operational excellence
Degree in scientific disciplines (mathematics, computer science, engineering, economics, physics)
Experience in main Python Data Science libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, Numpy, XGBoost, Pytorch, LightGBM, Tensorflow)
Experience in designing, developing and evaluating Statistical modeling or Machine Learning models (clustering, classification, regression, forecasting, …)
Excellent knowledge of the Office package, in particular Excel
Good knowledge of written and spoken English (B2)
Excellent propensity to work in a team, operational autonomy, proactivity, high level of commitment and result / output orientation
Strong ability to communicate effectively with the various organizational levels.




Nice to have:

Strong problem-solving skills (analysis of complex problems and structuring of solutions)
Excellent analytical and deductive skills, familiar with the design and evaluation of algorithms
Basic knowledge of IT architecture
Creativity and determination.




What we offer

We offer employment at manager level with the relevant salary, in accordance with the CCNL ANIA for non-executive employees and the Generali Group Company Agreement.

Gross annual salary ranging between 45K and 60K. The final offer will be aligned with the candidate’s professional experience, technical and soft skills relevant to the role, and may include an individual variable component.




We also offer:

Smart working and flexible hours
Corporate welfare system
Meal vouchers
Supplementary health insurance and discounted insurance policies
Well-being initiatives
Training and development
Structured continuous learning paths (technical and managerial)
Career development programs within the Group
Access to learning platforms and internal mobility opportunities, including international.

Title: Data Engineer | Machine Learning
Description:
Per azienda IT innovativa che opera nel campo della computer vision e dell’AI applicata al mondo fisico, facente parte di una holding strutturata, si ricerca un profilo di Data Engineer.




Attraverso tecnologie proprietarie e completamente privacy-compliant, sviluppano soluzioni in grado di analizzare flussi di persone e veicoli in spazi reali, trasformando il mondo fisico in dati digitali utilizzabili per il business.




Posizione

Siamo alla ricerca di un Data & Analytics Engineer con 2–4 anni di esperienza, che voglia crescere in un contesto tech ad alta complessità e diventare un punto di riferimento per l’analisi dei dati e l’evoluzione dell’infrastruttura data. Il/La candidato/a entrerà a far parte del team Tech R&D e collaborerà a stretto contatto con i team Operations e Product, contribuendo in modo concreto alla valorizzazione del dato lungo tutto il suo ciclo di vita: raccolta, validazione, modellazione, analisi e reporting.




Responsabilità

La risorsa avrà responsabilità su:

Estrazione, trasformazione e validazione di dati provenienti da database relazionali (MS SQL, PostgreSQL) e non relazionali (Cassandra)
Analisi di dataset complessi, con particolare attenzione a dati di mobilità e dati spazio-temporali
Produzione di insight ad alto valore aggiunto a partire dai dati raccolti
Preparazione di analisi e reportistica per clienti, traducendo i risultati in raccomandazioni operative chiare ed efficaci
Presentazione dei risultati ai clienti e agli stakeholder interni
Progettazione e sviluppo di algoritmi per l’identificazione di pattern, anomalie, dati mancanti e trend rilevanti
Supporto alla progettazione, sviluppo e gestione di pipeline dati ETL/ELT in Python e Databricks




Requisiti

- Must have:

Ottima conoscenza di Python e dei principali strumenti/librerie per data analysis e data engineering, come Pandas, PySpark
Familiarità con la programmazione orientata agli oggetti
Ottima conoscenza di database relazionali SQL-based
Esperienza con database non relazionali, preferibilmente Cassandra
Capacità di realizzare analisi e insight e capacità di presentarle, sia nella preparazione del materiale, sia nell'esposizione orale dei risultati a clienti e stakeholder interni




- Nice to have:

2–4 anni di esperienza in ambito data analytics e/o data engineering
Esperienza nella progettazione o manutenzione di pipeline dati ETL/ELT
Conoscenza di strumenti di data visualization, come Plotly o Seaborn
Esperienza nell’analisi di dati a forte componente spazio-temporale, come serie storiche, dati geolocalizzati o dati di mobilità
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata
Familiarità con ambienti cloud




Altre Informazioni

Sede: Milano, zona MM Precotto
Modalità di lavoro: ibrida
Range RAL: 35K-43K
Smart Working
