Title: Advanced Analytics and AI Lead
Description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

The Talent Advanced Analytics Lead is responsible for shaping and delivering the organization's next-generation Talent Intelligence and Advanced Analytics strategy. This role combines executive leadership advisory, advanced analytics, AI innovation, talent intelligence, and data product delivery to enable leaders to make faster, more informed decisions to unlock value and drive business impact.

The role serves as a strategic advisor to global Talent, Function, Service Line, and Sector leaders by transforming talent, business, operational, and external market data into actionable intelligence. The individual will lead the development of scalable analytics products, AI-powered insights, and agentic solutions that enhance planning, skills intelligence, talent mobility, employee experience, productivity, and organizational effectiveness.

Essential Functions:

Talent Intelligence Strategy & Executive Advisory


Partner with Global Talent Leadership, Function Talent Leaders, Service Line Leaders, and Planning leaders to define and execute the Talent Intelligence strategy.
Act as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, translating complex workforce trends into strategic recommendations and actionable decisions.
Drive data-informed decision making across planning, skills transformation, workforce evolution, talent acquisition, retention, learning, talent mobility, and succession planning, etc
Deliver executive-ready narratives that combine quantitative insights with business context and future workforce implications.
Influence enterprise talent priorities through predictive and prescriptive analytics.


Advanced Analytics & AI Solutions


Lead the development of advanced analytics models to identify workforce risks, forecast talent demand, predict workforce trends, and uncover opportunities to improve organizational performance.
Design and deploy AI-powered talent intelligence solutions using machine learning, Generative AI, natural language processing, knowledge graphs, and predictive modelling techniques.
Establish scalable approaches for skills intelligence, workforce segmentation, talent forecasting, organizational network analysis, and workforce optimization.
Define methodologies that combine internal talent data with external labour market intelligence and economic indicators.
Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and analytics techniques to advance talent decision science capabilities.


Generative AI, Copilot & Agentic Solutions


Lead development of AI-enabled experiences using Data Bricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI, enterprise GenAI platforms and machine learning, and intelligent automation capabilities.
Design and implement intelligent agents that automate talent insights generation, workforce analytics, executive insights, and decision support processes.
Build conversational analytics experiences that enable leaders to interact with talent data through natural language.
Establish governance, explainability, responsible AI, and adoption practices for AI-powered talent solutions.
Partner with technology teams to integrate agentic workflows into Talent operating models and business processes.
Drive experimentation and innovation through AI use cases that unlock measurable business value.


Data Products & Platform Leadership


Own the vision, roadmap, and lifecycle management of Talent analytics products and self-service insight solutions.
Lead development of enterprise Talent data products designed for broad organizational consumption.
Establish product management disciplines, user-centric design practices, and adoption strategies across Talent Intelligence initiatives.
Drive the transition from static reporting toward intelligent, scalable, reusable analytics products.
Identify opportunities to industrialize analytics capabilities and increase insight accessibility across stakeholder groups.
Enable scalable analytics architecture supporting structured and unstructured talent data.
Collaborate with Data Engineering and Technology teams to optimize data quality, governance, lineage, accessibility, and security.
Drive modernization of the talent analytics ecosystem through cloud-native analytics capabilities.


Insights, Storytelling & Executive Communications


Transform analytical outputs into compelling executive narratives and strategic workforce recommendations.
Create executive dashboards and insight products that simplify complex workforce information.
Develop thought leadership that shapes future Talent Intelligence capabilities and workforce decision-making practices.
Present findings confidently to executive talent leaders and senior business stakeholders.
Drive adoption of analytics by making insights easily understandable, relevant, and actionable.


Leadership & Capability Development


Lead and develop a high-performing team of data scientists, workforce strategists, analytics consultants, AI practitioners, and product managers.
Establish talent intelligence standards, methodologies, and governance frameworks.
Foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, continuous learning, and responsible AI usage.
Build organizational capabilities in analytics, AI literacy, data storytelling, and product thinking.
Manage delivery across global, offshore, vendor, and managed-service teams where applicable.


Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:


Determine strategic priorities for Talent Intelligence and Advanced Analytics programs.
Prioritize investments and resource allocation across analytics, AI, and data product portfolios.
Define and monitor key workforce intelligence metrics and success measures.
Evaluate emerging workforce trends, technologies, and market developments to influence strategic direction.
Balance innovation investments with operational scalability, governance, and business value realization.
Ensure responsible and ethical use of workforce data and AI solutions.


Knowledge and Skills Requirements:

Strategic & Business Skills


Deep understanding of Talent Intelligence, Planning, Talent Analytics, Workforce Evolution and Talent Strategy.
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and executive influence capabilities.
Ability to align talent analytics outcomes with broader business objectives.
Strong commercial acumen and understanding of organizational transformation.


Analytics & Data Science Skills


Advanced statistical analysis and predictive modelling, Machine Learning and AI solution design, Experimental design and causal inference methodologies, Skills intelligence and talent marketplace analytics, Expertise in data storytelling and executive reporting.


AI & Emerging Technology Skills


Generative AI solutions design and implementation, Microsoft Copilot ecosystem expertise, Copilot Studio and conversational AI development, Agentic AI architecture and orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns, Prompt engineering and AI governance, Responsible AI and model explainability, Knowledge management and semantic search solutions.


Data & Technology Skills


Data Bricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and advanced visualization.
SQL and advanced data modelling.
Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI, Enterprise GenAI platforms and Machine Learning
Python and R, Modern cloud analytics architectures.
API and data integration concepts, Data governance and metadata management.


Leadership Competencies


Executive presence, Strategic thinking, Innovation mindset, Change leadership.
Product-centric thinking, Collaboration across global teams, Enterprise influence and stakeholder engagement.
Ability to cope with ambiguity; to drive change and performance outcomes in a complex and agile environment.


Supervision Responsibilities:


Work closely with the Leads across Global Talent and wider Talent Functions to ensure the provision of services that support business and functional delivery.
Lead / manage a team of expert data analytics specialists responsible for functional execution, also build skills and capabilities of the team.
Develop AI capabilities, define key AI competencies for the team, and ensure provision of learning to advance skills
Independently maintain and leverage (when appropriate) an internal network, including effective partnerships with senior stakeholders, across EY practices / functions that will enable personal effectiveness in the position.


Other Requirements:


Due to global nature of the role; travel and willingness to work alternative hours will be required.
Due to global nature of the role; English language skills - excellent written and verbal communication will be required.


Job Requirements:

Education:


Bachelor’s degree in data science, Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Business Analytics, Organizational Psychology, Industrial Engineering, Human Resources, or related discipline.
Master's degree preferred.


Certification Requirements:


Higher professional or master’s qualification in a related discipline is preferred, not required
Active membership in related professional bodies or industry groups is preferred, not required
Microsoft certifications in MS Fabric, Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or Product Management certifications.
Professional certifications related to Planning, People Analytics, or Human Capital Management.


Experience:


18 to 20+ years of experience in Talent Analytics, Planning, Talent Intelligence, Data Science, AI, Copilot or related fields.
Demonstrated experience building enterprise-scale analytics, AI, or data product solutions as a consultant to external clients for talent domain.
Experience implementing Generative AI and Copilot-enabled business solutions.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric and modern cloud-based analytics environments.
Proven track record of delivering executive-level insights and strategic decision support.
Experience leading multidisciplinary global teams.
Experience managing complex stakeholder environments and large transformation initiatives.
Demonstrated success translating advanced analytics into business outcomes and measurable value realization.

Title: Junior - Credit Risk Modelling| Milan
Description:
Junior – Credit Risk Modelling| Milan

The chance to build a better future is right in front of you

Do Work That Matters - Your role and responsibilities

Do you want to pursue a profession that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, the company and colleagues address and solve the most current and complex challenges. KPMG Advisory offers consulting services to companies to assist them in business model transformation, process improvement and digitisation, risk analysis and management, and support in extraordinary finance transactions. When you join the Financial Risk team in Milan , you are going to work on Credit Risk Modelling projects, for top-tier clients in the Financial Services sector.

Specifically, you will be tasked with:


developing models for the quantification of the main credit risk parameters (PD, LGD and EAD) for management and regulatory purposes, in line with Basel regulations;
assisting clients with stress test;
contributing to the inclusion of ESG topics in risk measurement;
measurement of financial instruments (fixed income, securitisation and derivatives);
implementing pricing models for complex financial instruments (e.g., CLN, ABS, securitisation and CMS);
restructuring of derivative portfolios and development of the related financial models.


Skills

Come As You Are - Your skills and characteristics

This is the perfect opportunity if you have:


a specialist degree (graduate or nearing completion) in business, statistics, engineering, mathematics or any other quantitative faculty;
knowledge of programming software and languages (Python, SAS, R, Matlab and Stata);
excellent knowledge of Italian and English, preferably with study and/or work experience abroad;
excellent problem-solving skills and an innate ability to take initiative;
good interpersonal and teamwork skills.


Your Future With Us - What you’ll find at KPMG


An inclusive and equitable work environment that respects, encourages and values diversity.
A challenging and dynamic environment that encourages creativity and teamwork.
Hybrid work arrangements to promote a healthy work-life balance.
Advanced training and development programmes to stay current.
International mindset and innovative projects.
Initiatives focused on mental and physical well-being.


Standard employment contract under the collective labour agreement for the commerce sector, with a gross annual salary of €29,000. The salary is determined on the basis of objective criteria, including educational qualifications and an assessment of the candidate’s profile against the requirements of the role.

In accordance with applicable legislation, we do not collect or use information relating to remuneration received in current or previous employment. Our selection procedures are based on objective and gender-neutral criteria.

Together for Better – Our values and commitment

Leadership, teamwork, respect every individual, continuous learning, transparency, commitment to the community and integrity. These are the KPMG values that create an environment that encourages the sharing of ideas and knowledge, so our professionals can achieve their full potential.

As a result of our commitment to fostering an inclusive work environment, our Network complies with the standards of the ISO 30415 requirements, on the Diversity and Inclusion Management System, and UNI PdR 125, relating to gender equality” . Within our Impact Plan - Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) - you will find summarised all the actions we are taking on environmental, social and governance (ESG) issues.

Join us!

Collaborerai con altri ML & AI Engineers, sviluppatori full stack AI, data engineers e solution architects per integrare modelli ML/AI in architetture cloud moderne.
Scriverai codice Python/PySpark di alta qualità e SQL per l’analisi e la trasformazione dei dati.
Lavorerai con modelli tradizionali di Machine Learning e Deep Learning.
Svilupperai soluzioni basate su Large Language Models, con conoscenza di tecnologie come RAG e agenti intelligenti.
Progetterai e svilupperai pipeline di ML e soluzioni AI, dalla fase di prototipazione alla messa in produzione
Utilizzerai strumenti di MLOps e DevOps per la gestione, versionamento e deployment dei modelli.
Contribuirai al confronto con i clienti, traducendo esigenze di business in soluzioni AI efficaci.

Solida conoscenza di Python per il Machine Learning e la Data Science.
Solida conoscenza di SQL e modellazione dei dati.
Esperienza con librerie di Machine Learning (es. Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, Prophet).
Esperienza con i framework di Deep Learning (es. PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras).
Familiarità con strumenti di MLOps (es. MLFlow).
Esperienza con Large Language Models, tecniche di prompting e sistemi di Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Esperienza con piattaforme e servizi Cloud Microsoft come Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Fabric e/o Databricks (ML/GenAI).
Conoscenza delle pratiche di versionamento con Git, testing, CI/CD.
competenze di people management


Nice To Have


Esperienza con i principali framework per LLM come LangChain, LangGraph e LlamaIndex.
Esperienza con LLM open-source (LLaMA, Mistral, Mixtral) e tecniche di ottimizzazione (LoRA, fine-tuning).
Esperienza con Hugging Face Transformers.
Esperienza con servizi come AI Foundry.
Esperienza in deployment di modelli AI su infrastrutture containerizzate (Docker, Kubernetes).
Certificazioni rilevanti in ambito AI/ML, tra cui:
Microsoft: AZ-900, AI-900, AI-102, AI-100, DP-100, DP-600
Databricks: Machine Learning Associate, Machine Learning ---Professional, Databricks Certified GenAI Practitioner

Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science o discipline affini.
Analitico, curioso, agile, paziente e orientato alla qualità
Capacità di lavorare in team cross-funzionali e di comunicare efficacemente con stakeholder tecnici e non.
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata.

Description:
Sei un professionista motivato/a e desideroso/a di intraprendere un percorso di crescita in un ambiente dinamico e stimolante? BNP Paribas Cardif è alla ricerca di talenti come te per rafforzare il nostro team!

Chi cerchiamo?

Siamo alla ricerca di uno/una Technical Studies & Risk Monitoring Specialist con:


Buona conoscenza parlata e scritta della lingua inglese
Competenze informatiche in merito ai seguenti ambiti:
Power BI
SAS / SAS Enterprise Guide
Python: essenziale libreria PANDAS, gradita conoscenza librerie LIFELINES, DASK, NUMBA
MS Office
Flessibilità
Affidabilità
Capacità di lavorare in team
Proattività e spirito d’iniziativa/curiosità tecnica
Laurea in discipline quantitative: Actuarial Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Econometrics, Economics
Esperienza di 3/4 anni in uffici tecnici di compagnie di assicurazione (es: attuariato, data analytics), istituti finanziari o società di consulenza con focus sul settore assicurativo/finanziario

Di cosa si occupa l’area Attuariato in cui è inserita la posizione in ricerca?

L’ufficio Attuariato analizza dati statistici e finanziari per valutare rischi e prevedere costi futuri legati a eventi incerti, come malattie, mortalità, sinistri o pensionamenti.

Si può dire che l’attuariato trasforma dati complessi in informazioni chiave per la sottoscrizione e gestione del rischio, e la sostenibilità finanziaria dell’Azienda.

Cosa farai concretamente?

All’interno Dell’Ufficio Technical Studies & Risk Monitoring Stiamo Cercando Una Risorsa Che Ricopra Un Ruolo Operativo e Di Sviluppo Sulle Seguenti Attività

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
About The Company

Scrambly is one of the fastest-growing adtech startups in the world, featured in the AppsFlyer Performance Index and Singular ROI Index in just 3.5 years.

We’re growing 250%+ YoY across revenue, team, product, and technology — fully bootstrapped and profitable.

We’re building the future of app discovery: a reward-powered alternative to the App Store and Google Play. Our loyalty-driven ecosystem connects millions of users with the world’s top apps and delivers unmatched, ROI-focused growth for mobile advertisers.

Our mission is to build a true alternative to traditional app stores — fueled by rewards and data — and create a new, performance-first growth engine for mobile app advertisers.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to own the models behind how Scrambly spends and makes money — what our users are worth, what we should pay to acquire and reward them, and how we keep the ecosystem free of abuse.

The centre of the role is predicting user and cohort value — forecasting what people will be worth from early signal, and keeping those forecasts accurate as the product and the market move underneath them. Around it sits a set of connected problems across marketing, monetisation, and risk, each of which turns a prediction into a decision the business acts on. We will go through the specifics with you during the process.

You will own the modelling end to end: framing the problem, building the model, deciding how it is evaluated, and staying with it once it is live. You will not be doing that alone — you will work closely with our engineers on data, pipelines, serving, and integration.

This is an early hire on a data team being built from scratch, reporting to and working day to day with the Head of Data. We are flexible on level. The title reflects the ownership and independence the role carries, not a hard experience bar — we will set the level, title, and compensation to match what you bring.

Key Responsibilities


Value prediction. Own and improve how we forecast user and cohort value from early behaviour, across our different revenue streams. Improve accuracy where it matters most commercially, and keep the models working as the product changes.
Bidding and pricing. Build the modelling that decides what we are willing to pay to acquire users, together with the controls that keep spend inside margin limits while the system is still learning.
Segmentation and targeting. Build the scoring and segmentation that lets us treat users, partners, and inventory according to the value they actually deliver.
Fraud and abuse. Improve the accuracy of our fraud models, and balance catching abuse against wrongly penalising real users.
Evaluation. Decide how each model is judged and hold that line — out-of-sample discipline, backtesting, and choosing metrics that reflect the commercial objective rather than the convenient one. Stay close to your models once they are live, and flag when accuracy starts to slip.
Collaboration. Work with the Head of Data on prioritisation, with our engineers on data pipelines and serving, and with commercial teams on turning model output into decisions they trust.


Requirements


4+ years as a data scientist working on production models that drive real decisions. We care more about what you have owned than about the number.
Hands-on experience with LTV or ROAS prediction — forecasting user or cohort value from early behaviour, and dealing with the problems that come with it: immature cohorts, long horizons, sparse segments, and models that decay as the product changes. This is the core of the role and we are looking for someone who has done it before.
Adtech or mobile performance marketing background — attribution and MMP data, cohort and campaign economics, and how UA spend actually gets decided. Backgrounds in gaming, gambling, or user-incentive and loyalty systems are equally relevant, and experience with rewarded, offerwall, or incentivised apps is a significant advantage.
Strong Python and SQL, with production experience on a cloud data warehouse — BigQuery preferred.
Rigour about evaluation: you choose the metric that matches the business objective, you are careful about out-of-sample and point-in-time correctness, and you are willing to say a model is not good enough to ship.
Experience of models that made it into production and were used to make real decisions — you understand what it takes to get there and what happens to a model afterwards.
Commercial judgement and clear communication — able to explain a model to people who will spend money based on it, and to push back when the data does not support the question being asked.
A proactive, self-directed way of working. You will be in a very small team, with a lot of latitude and little process.
English at B2+, written and spoken — you will document your work and work daily with an international team.


Nice to Have


Bidding, pricing, or budget allocation systems — control loops, bandits, or other approaches to spending under uncertainty.
Fraud, anomaly detection, or trust & safety modelling, especially with weak or incomplete labels.
Experimentation and causal inference — A/B design, power analysis, and incrementality measurement.
Survival, hierarchical, or Bayesian methods applied to retention, monetisation, or sparse-segment problems.
BQML, Dataform, or dbt, or other experience building models close to the warehouse.
Deploying and monitoring models yourself — pipelines, serving, retraining, and drift monitoring.


What We Offer


Ownership of the models that set UA spend, offer payouts, and fraud decisions — work directly attached to revenue, with visible impact within weeks.
Problems with real depth: long-horizon forecasting, adaptivity, pricing under uncertainty, and fraud with imperfect ground truth.
A close working relationship with the Head of Data, a real say in how the data function is built, and room to grow as the team expands.
A level and compensation matched to what you bring, rather than to the title on the advert.
A profitable, bootstrapped company growing 250%+ YoY, where investment in data is justified by results rather than budget cycles.


By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Job description




Let's build the future of AI & Data, together 🧙




At Data Wizards, we're focused on 3 things: Data, AI & you.




We're a small team who genuinely love digging into data that makes a real difference for the companies we work with, and who want to discover how AI and data can help companies out there.




Why join us? Apart from tackling exciting challenges with passionate people in an environment that wants to see you thrive, you'll be part of a young company that keeps its feet on the ground, its eyes on the stars, and believes the best growth comes from the unique magic each Wizard brings.




We are continuously on the lookout for bright data engineers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, AI engineers, and data analysts. But this job description is for Senior Data Scientists out there feeling the magic in them and ready to spread it 🪄




We are currently looking for a senior data scientist for a fraud detection project where you would do:




Strengthening our fraud models by improving how we collect, label, structure and engineer features from complex transactional and behavioral data
Designing, building and continuously refining fraud detection models using machine learning, graph analytics, anomaly detection and behavioral analytics
Turning large volumes of transactional and customer data into actionable fraud intelligence through feature engineering, data enrichment and pattern discovery
Partnering with Fraud Operations, Risk, Compliance and Product teams to spot emerging fraud trends and translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions
Digging into complex fraud schemes, uncovering new attack vectors and building proactive detection strategies that protect the business financially and reputationally
But being a consulting company, we can't know in advance what your exact responsibilities will be




Job requirements




You’re a step closer to joining our team if you bring:




Background




At least 5 years of experience in data science, with a solid grounding in fraud detection, ideally within the financial sector
A Master's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, computer science or engineering. A PhD is a plus, and candidates with a different academic background but strong analytical skills are equally welcome




Technical Skills




Hands-on experience processing large-scale, complex transactional and behavioral datasets using SQL, Python (Pandas) and distributed processing frameworks such as Spark or Hadoop
Proven ability to apply supervised and unsupervised machine learning, anomaly detection, graph analytics and network analysis to detect, investigate and prevent fraud. Experience with generative AI is a plus
Strong Python skills, with experience deploying AI applications into production; familiarity with Java is a plus




Soft Skills




Autonomous & Proactive: You take initiative and drive projects forward.
Curious & Adaptive: You embrace learning and thrive in dynamic environments.
Solution-Oriented: You balance technical rigor with business impact.
Clear Communicator: You simplify complex ideas for diverse audiences.
Collaborative & Supportive: You work well in teams.
Creative Thinker: You find innovative solutions to challenging problems.
Languages: Fluent in English, French and/or Dutch.




We know that finding the right job isn’t just about the role, it’s about what’s in it for you, too. While we’re a start-up, we’re big on taking care of our people right from day one.




Here's a sneak peek at what we offer:




💰 A compensation package that keeps you motivated




Competitive salary
Mobility budget or company car with an electrical card
30 days of paid time off
A top-tier laptop & smartphone with a subscription
Representation allowances
Group, hospitalization & dental insurance
Meal vouchers & eco-cheques
Opportunity to earn company stock over time




🌱 A place to be your best self, grow, and thrive




Work with the most innovative technologies in Data & AI
Work in an agile, collaborative environment
Hybrid work model: up to 3 days per week
Monthly team-building events (plus one epic annual celebration)
Tailored training programs to fuel your career growth
A cool, ergonomic office with creative meeting spaces, a Nintendo Switch for spontaneous Mario Kart battles, a massage chair for those deep-thinking moments and fresh coffee & drinks to keep you energized ☕




✨ And most importantly, an organic-growing company where you are in control of your own path!




Our Recruitment Process:




📲Quick intro call with our HR team (5')

💜Culture check: HR Interview (30')

🛠️Technical check: Wizard assessment (25') & Technical Interview with our wizards (1h)

🤝Partner Meet-up (30')




Why this process?

We want you to get a genuine feel for who we are, and we want to make sure we're aligned on what truly matters. Rather than rushing the process, we focus on finding the right fit, so that six months from now, both sides are still convinced they made the right decision.




➡️If you're passionate about what we do but aren't sure you meet every single requirement, don't hesitate to apply. We value potential, mindset, and growth as much as experience. At Data Wizards, we believe diversity is our strength. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences because different viewpoints help us grow and evolve.




➡️Please note: As a consulting company, our recruitment process can be either project-driven or based on strong profiles we believe in. The consultancy world moves fast, and while we always aim to match great talent with the right opportunity, there might not always be an immediate fit. With your permission, we'll gladly keep your profile in mind for future missions, and hope to collaborate with you soon on an exciting project at Data Wizards!

Title: Data Scientist H/F
Description:
À propos de nous

Nous sommes le premier industriel de la donnée en Europe. Notre métier est de créer, manager et exploiter le patrimoine data de nos clients.

Nous avons la conviction que chaque entreprise peut adopter une démarche innovante de gestion de la donnée et créer des cas d’usage disruptifs en réduisant l'impact écologique et en diminuant la dette technique.

Nous comptons plus de 900 collaborateurs en mission chez nos clients grands comptes dans tout secteur d’activité : banque, assurance, santé, énergie, e-commerce, automobile, luxe, retail, transport, agritech…

Avantages à travailler chez JEMS


Une JEMS Académie au service de votre montée en compétences (formations et certifications sur les technologies de pointe)
Un accompagnement personnalisé et un management de proximité pour vous proposer des évolutions de carrière
Une intégration dans des communautés techniques et de pratiques JEMS (encadrement par des experts, échanges sur les bonnes pratiques, favoriser l'innovation...)
Une entreprise reconnue "Great Place To Work"
Des évènements et séminaires inoubliables, des soirées d'agence conviviales


Mobilité

Une mobilité nationale et internationale pour vous accompagner dans vos projets de vie.

Diversité

Le Groupe JEMS porte fièrement sa valeur "Diversité" en se mobilisant pour l'inclusion et l'égalité des chances et en luttant contre toutes formes de discrimination.

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Mission

Vous Aurez La Charge De

Nous recherchons un(e) Data Scientist capable de trouver des solutions innovantes et robustes à l'ensemble des problématiques Data. Gourou de la donnée, vous vous amusez à faire parler les données et à les mettre au service des entreprises. Vous êtes donc à la croisée d'enjeux fonctionnels et stratégiques :


Étudier des données en possession de l’entreprise
Définir et récupérer des données pertinentes à extraire et à traiter en lien avec la production de l’entreprise, la vente ou encore liées aux données clients
Développer des algorithmes permettant d’améliorer les résultats de recherches et de ciblages
Élaborer des modèles prédictifs afin d’anticiper l’évolution des données et tendances relatives à l’activité de l’entreprise

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Senior Data Scientist | Brussels




At Exsolvæ, our consultants carry the title of Solver, and it's a title you earn. We take the development of every Solver seriously, each one belongs to a Core Domain, works with a Leader who actually follows their progress, and presents their work in Cerebro sessions to colleagues who know the field as well as they do. It's a demanding place, on purpose.




The Data Science & AI Core Domain serves some of the biggest names across finance, retail, automotive, etc.




For this mission, you'll join the marketing data science team of a leading company in Belgium, building responsible AI models that make campaigns more relevant for millions of customers.




That's the work we're hiring for.




Your role, on mission

Build responsible AI models that make marketing campaigns more relevant and impactful, from target group selection to customer journey driven campaigns (next best action)
Use LLMs and fine-tuned models to turn large volumes of unstructured text, such as client interaction notes and web analytics data, into insights on products discussed, customer intent and feedback
Own the full lifecycle: capturing business needs, assessing feasibility, building models and data pipelines, deploying and monitoring them in production
Set up rigorous evaluation: experiment design, impact measurement, guardrails and validation of LLM-driven predictions
Build feedback loops and dashboards that let business users correct predictions and keep models learning
Bring MLOps best practices to the team (MLflow, reproducible models and datasets)
Translate technical results into clear, actionable insights for business owners, and guide junior data scientists along the way




Your role, within the community

Share what you learn: Cerebro sessions, co-built playbooks, code reviews between Solvers
Mentor peers and be mentored: seniors who enjoy passing on what they know do well here
Help shape where the Core Domain goes next




Must-haves

Master's degree in a quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, computer science); other academic backgrounds with substantial data science experience are welcome
Senior profile: minimum 5 years of relevant experience in data science
Expert Python and its data science ecosystem (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow), with solid engineering practices (git, bash, SQL)
Expertise in customer journey modeling
Solid understanding of statistical methods, experiment design and machine learning, both traditional and deep learning
Proven expertise using LLMs for text classification, including interpretability, guardrails and validation of LLM-driven predictions
Fluent English, plus fluent French or Dutch
Based in Belgium and available on-site in Brussels 50% of the time
A genuine desire to be part of a community: you share what you know and you show up for the collective moments




Strong assets

Incremental learning and closed feedback loops
Uplift modeling
Marketing Mix Modeling and optimization under constraints
MLOps: MLflow, model monitoring and delivery pipelines
SAS, Streamlit
Financial services background




Joining Exsolvæ, concretely

A community before anything else: a Core Domain led by a Leader who follows your development, Cerebro sessions where Solvers present and learn, playbooks built together
A Knowledge & Networking budget to keep learning and stay plugged into the ecosystem (emerging AI topics, MLOps, AI governance)
A followed career path with a dedicated Manager, regular check-ins, an evolution committee that formalises your progression and issues recommendations
Long-run missions at leading companies, in production
A permanent employee contract, with a competitive package




Interested, or know someone who fits? Apply here or reach out to us!

Title: Senior Data Scientist – MMM Expert
Description:
Join Artefact Belgium: Help our clients in their AI transformations

Who We Are

Artefact is a next-generation consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in AI applications to help clients achieve tangible business impact. Our Belgium office advises clients on their most pressing strategic challenges : from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design. Our inclusive and forward-thinking culture encourages creativity, collaboration, and professional growth.

What You Will Do

As a Senior Data Scientist specializing in the marketing domain, you will lead and conduct ambitious projects aimed at transforming clients through data. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:


Leading transformational projects: spearheading ambitious projects that utilize data to transform our clients’ operations and strategies.
Developing data science solutions: creating innovative data science products and solutions for both clients and our internal data science team.
Applying data science in marketing contexts: leveraging data science methodologies to enhance marketing analytics, customer segmentation, attribution modeling, and campaign optimization.
Building client relationships: collaborating closely with your Consulting counterpart to understand client needs and strengthen relationships.
Upskilling the team: contributing to the development of our data science team by sharing knowledge, mentoring junior Data Scientists, and promoting our work within other data departments.
Ensuring quality deliverables: caring for team morale and ensuring that all missions are delivered to a high standard, providing feedback and support to less experienced team members.
Optimising code: writing highly optimized code to advance Artefact’s internal toolbox and knowledge base.


What You Will Learn With Us


Real-World impact: deliver impactful projects by developing end-to-end machine learning pipelines to solve real-world problems across various industries, including marketing and customer intelligence.
Collaborative solutions: work in feature teams alongside other data scientists, ML engineers, data engineers, software engineers, and product owners to build complex solutions.
Software engineering improvement: enhance your software engineering skills by applying ML Ops best practices while working with machine learning teams.
Expertise development: become an expert in one of our data science practices: Time Series Forecasting, MLOps, NLP, Computer Vision, Optimization, or Customer Intelligence, including marketing analytics, attribution modeling, and incrementality testing.
Algorithm discovery: discover state-of-the-art algorithms and test them on real-world data during client projects.


Who You Are

We’re seeking someone who has:


Educational background: a completed Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., computer science, machine learning, mathematics, or related subjects).
Hands-On experience: at least 2-3 years of experience in data science, analytics, or consulting, preferably within a marketing or digital context.
Marketing or digital context experience: knowledge of various marketing channels and platforms, including their roles within the media mix is considered a plus.
Technical skills: strong knowledge of data processing, algorithms, and data architecture, along with proficiency in tools like Python, SQL, and R.
Analytical mindset: a passion for working with data to derive actionable insights and solve complex problems.
Communication skills: excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to discuss both technical and non-technical topics with clients and team members.
Curiosity and passion: a genuine interest in continuous learning and exploring new technologies and tools in data and AI.


What We Offer


Competitive compensation aligned with your profile and experience.
Hands-on exposure to real client challenges from day one, working alongside experienced strategy and data/AI practitioners.
Regular training in both strategy consulting methodologies and AI/data capabilities, combined with international exposure across Artefact's global network.
A collaborative, entrepreneurial culture of doers — innovative, fast-moving, and committed to supporting each other's growth.


This position is based in Brussels, with opportunities to collaborate on projects worldwide.

At Artefact Belgium, we value curiosity, motivation, and potential above all else. Don't worry if you don't tick every box — if you're excited about building a career at the frontier of strategy and AI, we'd love to hear from you

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Position Description

The opportunity

Join CGI's multidisciplinary innovation environment and help clients turn data into decisions, products and new ways of working. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will frame complex business questions, design robust analytical approaches and build AI and machine-learning solutions that create practical value.

You will combine technical delivery with consulting: translating emerging trends into relevant client solutions, making insights easy to understand, supporting business development and helping less-experienced colleagues grow.

Only candidates legally residing in Belgium will be considered for this position.

C2-level in one of the 2 national languages and at least B2-level in the other and strong English proficiency is also mandatory.

What you will do


Frame the right problems. Work with clients and multidisciplinary teams to translate business challenges into clear analytical questions, hypotheses, success measures and realistic delivery plans.
Build advanced analytics solutions. Develop, evaluate and improve machine-learning and statistical models for classification, regression, forecasting, NLP and other relevant use cases.
Create reliable experiments. Explore and prepare data, select appropriate methods, design experiments and validate results with attention to quality, bias, explainability and business relevance.
Make insights actionable. Translate model outputs and complex findings into clear visualisations, recommendations and narratives that decision-makers can understand and use.
Support industrialisation. Collaborate with data, software and cloud engineers to move promising models towards secure, maintainable and scalable production solutions.
Shape client strategy and growth. Connect industry and technology trends to client operations, contribute to workshops and proposals, and help create new opportunities with existing and prospective CGI clients.
Mentor and collaborate. Coach colleagues, review approaches and share good practices while working openly with experts from different disciplines to find the strongest solution.


What you bring


Relevant education and experience. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Econometrics or another discipline with a strong statistical component, plus at least 5 years of experience in the data domain.
Python and/or R. Strong practical skills with the data-science ecosystem, including tools such as pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, matplotlib or equivalent libraries.
Machine learning and advanced analytics. Proven experience solving complex problems through data analysis, modelling and evaluation, including classification and regression techniques.
Natural language processing. Experience with NLP concepts and libraries such as spaCy, NLTK or Stanford NLP, and the ability to select an appropriate approach for the use case.
Data and cloud platforms. Experience with advanced analytics and large datasets, together with practical knowledge of at least one major cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
Consulting and communication. Strong problem-solving, stakeholder and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical choices and results to non-specialist audiences.
Agile collaboration. Comfort working iteratively in Agile environments, taking ownership of deliverables and collaborating across business, data, engineering and design disciplines.
Additional assets. Experience in software development or DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, MLOps, computer vision, Unity, Linked Data, semantic technologies or knowledge graphs is an advantage.


A pre-employment screening is part of the application process.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

Title: Data Scientist - Weather & Short-Term Power
Description:
Data Scientist – Weather & Short-Term Power (HL 14)

📍 Location: Brussels

About ENGIE and Supply & Energy Management:

ENGIE, a global leader in low-carbon energy and services, relies on its Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management (GBU S&EM) to provide reliable, sustainable, and affordable energy to all its customers. This strategic unit optimizes the Group’s and clients’ production assets and designs tailored energy solutions for our 200,000 professional clients and 15 million consumers.

The Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management leverages ENGIE’s assets to deliver secure and sustainable energy to its B2B and B2C customers. It uses its expertise in energy management to provide decarbonized electricity 24/7.

Joining Supply & Energy Management means becoming part of a team of over 10,000 passionate experts spread across 20 countries, all united by a shared mission: shaping a greener and more efficient energy future. Together, we push the boundaries of innovation to deliver decarbonized energy 24/7. Join us and be part of those shaping the energy of tomorrow!

Context

The Expertise Center Market Analysis and the Business Platform Power Trading, Structuring & Origination (PTSO) are looking for a Data Scientist – Weather & Short-Term Power to join the Short-Term Power Market Analysis (STP) team in Brussels. The position sits on the trading floor, embedded in an extended team of market analysts, meteorologists, hydrologists and data scientists.

The STP team covers short-term power markets — week-ahead, day-ahead, intraday, ancillary and imbalance — in support of trading and portfolio management activities in Central Western Europe (CWE). Weather has become the dominant driver of these markets: renewable generation, demand and prices are increasingly shaped by it, and extracting value from weather information is one of the team’s key priorities.

This is not a conventional power analyst position. We are looking for a data scientist with strong weather expertise, or a quantitative meteorologist, to act as a bridge between two teams: as a member of the STP team, the successful candidate will also be integrated in the Meteo & Climate team, strengthening the collaboration between them. Above all, the candidate will work in close daily contact with our internal clients: the short-term power trading and asset optimization desks.

Your Mission

As Data Scientist – Weather & Short-Term Power, your mission is to turn weather data into market value: translating weather forecasts — and their uncertainty — into actionable signals, forecasts and strategies for the short-term power trading and asset optimization desks.

Your main activities:


Develop, industrialize and maintain weather-driven forecast products and trading signals for day-ahead, intraday and imbalance markets, owning the full model lifecycle from research to production.
Exploit deterministic and ensemble weather forecasts (post-processing, calibration, skill evaluation) to extract predictive value for renewable generation, demand and prices in CWE.
Work daily with the trading desks: understand their needs, deliver weather intelligence in actionable form, and communicate forecast confidence and risks clearly and on time.
Act as the bridge between the STP and Meteo & Climate teams: co-develop tools and data pipelines, spread weather best practices within STP, and bring power market awareness to the weather team.
Monitor upcoming weather and alert traders and analysts on market-moving weather events and forecast revisions.
Contribute to the team’s roadmap, dashboards and digital platforms, staying ahead of advances in weather forecasting, data science and AI.


Hard Skills

What we are looking for


In-depth knowledge of Numerical Weather Prediction models and weather data, including ensemble forecasting and reanalysis datasets.
Strong Python and data science skills: machine learning applied to time series, statistical post-processing, uncertainty quantification, and handling of large meteorological datasets.
Experience building, deploying and maintaining models in production; familiarity with cloud-based technologies (AWS, GCP or Azure) is a plus.
Knowledge of (short-term) power markets is a plus — a strong appetite to learn them is a must.


Soft Skills


Clear and effective communication, written and verbal: able to convey complex weather and model topics to traders and non-specialists.
Strong team spirit and collaborative mindset — you will operate across two teams and several desks.
Reactivity, autonomy and composure in a fast-paced trading-floor environment.
Curiosity, creativity and a solution-oriented attitude.


Education & Experience


Master’s degree or PhD in meteorology, atmospheric sciences, physics, applied mathematics, engineering or a related field.
3 to 5 years of experience in weather forecasting, data science applied to weather, or quantitative analysis — ideally in the energy sector.


Languages


Fluent in English.
French and/or Dutch is a plus.


Why join us?


A unique position at the crossroads of weather science and power trading, with direct daily exposure to trading decisions.
Integration in two expert teams — Short-Term Power and Meteo & Climate — with genuine intellectual depth and a strong collaborative culture.
Access to best-in-class weather data, proprietary data infrastructure and high-performance computing environments.
Autonomy, real responsibilities and the possibility to grow, learn and develop, including attendance to conferences.


Diversity & Inclusion

If you meet these requirements, then you are the talent we are looking for. Don’t wait – apply now with your CV.

At ENGIE S&EM, we are committed to fostering a gender-neutral and inclusive environment where everyone’s potential can thrive.

All our positions are open to people with disabilities. If you need any reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please inform your recruiter — we will be happy to support you.

About ENGIE

ENGIE is a global leader in low-carbon energy and services, committed to accelerating the transition towards a carbon-neutral world. Our purpose (“raison d’être”) is clear: act to reduce energy consumption and develop cleaner, more sustainable solutions that balance economic performance with a positive impact on people and the planet.

We rely on our core businesses — gas, power, renewable energy, and services — to deliver competitive, tailored solutions to our customers worldwide.

With 96,000 employees and a strong network of partners and stakeholders, ENGIE is more than a company: we are a community of Imaginative Builders, working every day to create harmonious, sustainable progress.

ENGIE is committed to promoting Equal Opportunity employment. We pro-actively foster an inclusive environment that not only embraces but celebrates diversity. Our goal is for all employees to experience a real sense of belonging. We aim to provide them with a safe and inclusive working environment in which they feel empowered to thrive and excel. Join us and embark on the adventure of the century. Be a transition maker, accomplish more and change our world! It's our reality. At ENGIE, we don’t just talk about change, we make it happen!

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Join BNP Paribas Fortis' AI Tribe, a team of 90+ AI experts driving innovation across the bank through advanced analytics and Artificial Intelligence.

As a Data Scientist specialized in Fraud Detection, you will design and deploy cutting-edge AI solutions to combat evolving financial crime threats. Combining machine learning, graph analytics, and Generative AI, you will transform data into actionable intelligence that helps protect our customers, strengthen the bank's resilience, and shape the future of fraud prevention.

AND IN DETAIL

As a Data Scientist specialized in Fraud Detection, you'll design, build, and deploy AI solutions to help protect our bank and customers from evolving fraud threats. You'll work within our AI Tribe and collaborate with Fraud Operations, Risk, and Compliance teams to transform data into actionable fraud prevention and detection capabilities.

What You'll Do


Develop and enhance fraud detection models using machine learning, anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, and graph analytics.
Analyze large-scale transactional and behavioral data to uncover suspicious patterns and emerging fraud schemes.
Engineer features, enrich datasets, and apply a data-centric and error-analysis approach to continuously improve model performance.
Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into scalable AI solutions.
Investigate complex fraud cases, identify emerging attack vectors, and proactively mitigate risks.
Leverage advanced AI techniques (traditional machine learning and also LLMs and Generative AI), to support fraud investigations and strengthen fraud prevention capabilities.
Stay ahead of AI and fraud trends to continuously enhance our detection and prevention strategies


YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Education & Experience


Master’s in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or related field (PhD a plus).
3+ years in Data Science, preferably in financial services/fraud detection.
Experience with fraud analytics, AML, or financial crime prevention.


Technical Skills


Data-Centric AI & Data Engineering: Data collection, labeling, curation, enrichment, feature engineering, data quality, feedback, and large-scale data processing.
AI & Fraud Analytics:
Machine Learning: Supervised and unsupervised learning for anomaly and fraud detection, model evaluation, performance monitoring, and error analysis.
Advanced Analytics: Graph analytics, network analytics, behavioral analytics, and financial crime analytics.
Generative AI & Foundation Models: LLMs, RAG, AI agents, deep learning , transactional model and AI-driven fraud prevention solutions.
Programming & AI Engineering: Advanced Python, software engineering best practices, AI application development and deployment, monitoring, and end-to-end AI lifecycle management.

Soft Skills


Analytical, proactive, and results-driven.
Strong communicator who thrives in multidisciplinary teams.
Comfortable in an international, fast-paced environment.


Languages


Fluent English + Dutch or French (professional level).


What We Have To Offer

Sustainability and impact

We strongly believe in the positive impact that the financial sector can have on the world. BNP Paribas Fortis offers sustainable and responsible investment products and solutions and encourages social entrepreneurship. Together with our customers, we are working towards a better future every day.

DEVELOPMENT & CAREER PERSPECTIVES

We offer a wide range of training courses, workshops and webinars to choose from depending on your availability, interests and goals.

GOOD PLACE TO WORK

In addition to your remuneration and benefits (meal vouchers, insurance, holidays), we offer flexible salary options, allowing you to convert part of your salary into personalised benefits (phone use, IT equipment, transport, etc.).

OUR ENGAGEMENT

At BNP Paribas Fortis, we want to attract and retain all talent, whatever their gender, age, background or sexual orientation, and irrespective of whether they are living with a disability, as every person has their own experiences and their own identity. Title: Data Scientist - McKinsey Transformation
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

You will expand your expertise across various analytics topics, encompassing descriptive analytics as well as the design, development, and refinement of statistical models, optimization techniques, advanced machine learning, and predictive models like boosted trees.

Working closely with a cross-functional team of data scientists, data engineers, product developers, and analytics-focused consultants, your core responsibility involves collaborating with product management to build performant, robust, and maintainable analytics products that adhere to established data-science approaches and best practices.

Furthermore, you will be driving the fine-tuning and evaluation of LLMs requires leveraging the latest advancements in neural network architectures and machine learning techniques, optimizing their performance and efficiency particularly for segmentation use cases. Accelerating this development and problem-solving process involves utilizing cutting-edge GenAI tools such as Claude and Cursor, alongside implementing efficient development and maintenance workflows (MLOps) within our Databricks platform.

Translating these complex data analyses into actionable analytical insights directly guides client project directions, while simultaneously fueling your contributions to internal knowledge sharing, research, and technical documentation focused on unstructured data, LLMs, and predictive modeling. Ultimately, all these efforts converge to bring advanced analytics capabilities into one of the firm's flagship products, "Wave" serving as the backbone for how McKinsey runs future transformations and utilizing powerful data science assets to dramatically improve the odds of success for our clients.

You will work in our McKinsey Client Capabilities Network in EMEA and will be part of our Wave Transformatics team.

Wave is a McKinsey SaaS product that equips clients to successfully manage improvement programs and transformations. Focused on business impact, Wave allows clients to track the impact of individual initiatives and understand how they affect longer term goals. It is a mix of an intuitive interface and McKinsey business expertise that gives clients a simple and insightful picture of what can otherwise be a complex process by allowing them to track the progress and performance of initiatives against business goals, budget and time frames.

Our Transformatics team builds data and AI products to provide analytics insights to clients and McKinsey teams involved in transformation programs across the globe. The current team is composed of 3 data engineers, 5 data scientists,1 analyst and 2 PMs who are spread across several geographies. The team covers a variety of industries, functions, analytics methodologies and platforms – e.g. Cloud data engineering, advanced statistics, machine learning, predictive analytics, MLOps and generative AI.

Your Qualifications and Skills


MSc or PhD level in the field of computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics or equivalent by experience
1+ years of experience in data science, statistical modelling (e.g. advanced regressions, clustering, classification models) and machine learning techniques (e.g. random forest, support vector machines, gradient boosting, XGBoost)
Programming experience in the following languages: Python and SQL. Basic understanding of PySpark
Comfortable leveraging the latest GenAI tools (such as Cursor or Claude) to accelerate coding, debugging, and problem-solving.
Experience with version control using Git and collaborative development workflows in GitHub (e.g., branching, pull requests, code reviews, and repository management)
Experience collaborating on projects to deploy advanced analytics and data science methods in real-world organizations (CI/CD, deployment observation, etc...)
Familiarity with LLMs agents, RAG systems, prompt engineering, machine learning libraries (scikit-learn) or deep learning libraries (TensorFlow/PyTorch) is a plus
Exposure to tools like Databricks and Tableau is a plus
Effective communication skills, including a readiness to break down analytical concepts, methods, and results for non-technical stakeholders. (e.g. consultants, etc...)

Title: Data scientist
Description:
Votre mission

Rejoignez Partenamut, la première mutualité libre et francophone de Belgique et engagez-vous dans un parcours professionnel et personnel où l'humain est au cœur de tout. Ici, nous sommes prêts à construire la mutualité de demain, encore plus à l'écoute et innovante. Chaque jour, nous accompagnons plus d'1,3 million de clients dans la gestion proactive de leur santé, mais surtout, nous formons une équipe collaborative et solidaire. Vos talents et votre singularité s'expriment librement pour atteindre nos objectifs communs.

Nous croyons en l'épanouissement centré sur l'humain, l'innovation, la solidarité et la diversité. Si l'innovation vous passionne et que l'humain vous anime, si vous êtes prêt à vous couper en quatre pour nos clients tout en restant entier, et si vous aimez vous challenger au travail tout en profitant de votre temps libre, nous sommes impatients de vous rencontrer pour construire ensemble la santé et le bien-être de demain.

Vos responsabilités

En tant que Data Scientist, vous transformez les données et les technologies d’IA en solutions concrètes, utiles et responsables pour répondre aux enjeux métiers de l’entreprise.


Vous concevez et développez des solutions Data & IA répondant à des besoins métiers concrets, en exploitant des données structurées et non structurées et des technologies telles que le Machine Learning, les LLM, le RAG, la compréhension documentaire et les agents IA.
Vous transformez les expérimentations en solutions opérationnelles, en évaluant leur qualité, leur fiabilité et leur valeur métier, puis en les rendant robustes, maintenables et scalables.
Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes produit et data — Product Owners, Data Engineers, Data Analysts, développeurs RPA et autres experts — afin de traduire les problématiques métier en solutions Data & IA efficaces.
Vous collaborez avec les équipes architecture, DevOps, sécurité, privacy et métier pour garantir un déploiement responsable et efficace, avec les niveaux appropriés de sécurité, de conformité, de monitoring et de supervision humaine.
Vous contribuez au développement de capacités IA réutilisables et promouvez les bonnes pratiques d’ingénierie : évaluation et tests, MLOps/LLMOps, observabilité, software engineering, documentation et CI/CD.
Vous explorez les nouvelles technologies et capacités en IA, identifiez celles qui peuvent réellement créer de la valeur et transformez les opportunités pertinentes en expérimentations et solutions concrètes.
Vous partagez vos connaissances et challengez les idées, en contribuant activement à une culture d’équipe collaborative, orientée apprentissage et amélioration continue.
Vous évoluez au sein d’une équipe multidisciplinaire où l’expertise, la curiosité et l’envie de construire des solutions utiles comptent autant que la technologie — avec, idéalement, quelques conversations qui n’ont absolument rien à voir avec l’IA.


Vos atouts

Votre Profil En Tant Que Data Scientist


Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master ou d’un PhD, idéalement en informatique, mathématiques, data science ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous combinez un solide esprit analytique avec un réel intérêt pour la data, le software et l’IA.
Vous disposez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience pratique dans la conception et le développement de solutions Data & IA, idéalement en tant que Data Scientist, ML Engineer ou AI Engineer. Vous avez notamment travaillé avec des données non structurées (textes, documents, images) et utilisé des LLM pour répondre à des problématiques métiers concrètes.
Vous maîtrisez les fondamentaux du Machine Learning et de l’IA et savez choisir l’approche la plus pertinente en fonction du problème : Machine Learning traditionnel, IA générative ou solutions plus simples.
Vous êtes à l’aise avec les approches modernes de l’IA générative, notamment le prompt engineering, le RAG, les sorties structurées, l’utilisation d’outils et les workflows agentiques. Une expérience en évaluation, guardrails, human-in-the-loop ou LLMOps constitue un atout.
Vous maîtrisez Python et êtes capable de développer des solutions prêtes pour la production, au-delà du simple prototype. Vous avez une expérience du déploiement et de l’exploitation de workloads IA sur AWS. Des connaissances en SQL, API, CI/CD et développement cloud-native sont un plus.
Vous êtes attentif à la qualité et à la fiabilité des solutions : vous savez évaluer si une solution IA fonctionne réellement, la tester, la monitorer et l’améliorer dans le temps.
Vous êtes autonome, proactif et collaboratif, et appréciez de travailler avec des profils variés : Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Product Owners, architectes, experts métier et autres profils techniques. Vous savez challenger une approche et proposer des alternatives pertinentes.
Vous êtes pragmatique, curieux et capable de prendre du recul sur l’IA : vous savez distinguer les innovations réellement utiles du simple effet de mode et expliquer des concepts techniques complexes de manière claire et accessible. Vous maîtrisez le français et l’anglais à un niveau professionnel ; le néerlandais est un atout. Vous ne devez pas nécessairement cocher toutes les cases : si vous apprenez rapidement, disposez de bases solides et avez le bon état d’esprit, nous serons ravis d’échanger avec vous.


Notre offre


Un contrat temps plein à durée indéterminée avec horaires flexibles et la possibilité de faire du télétravail jusqu’à 3 jours par semaine.
Une fonction passionnante avec de réelles perspectives d’avenir dans une entreprise en forte croissance.
Une formation approfondie au secteur de la mutualité à votre arrivée et des formations régulières tout au long de votre carrière.
Un salaire attrayant assorti de nombreux avantages extra-légaux modulables en fonction de vos besoins.
Jusqu’à 46 jours de congés par an.
Lieu de travail : Bruxelles.
Merci de noter qu’aucune candidature envoyée par un bureau de consultance externe ne sera acceptée si le bureau n’a pas été expressément mandaté pour cette recherche par Partenamut.


Vous voulez participer au succès de Partenamut ?

Cliquez sur « postuler » pour accéder à notre formulaire de candidature online.

Title: Data Scientist - HQ Brussels

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Tribe Artificial Intelligence aims to deliver an efficient and seamless banking experience for our customers and empower our employees through AI. Our expert team of approximately 90 experts includes Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, Product Owners and Managers. We are seeking a Data Scientist with a minimum of 3 years of experience in developing AI applications, including both generative and predictive AI.

AND IN DETAIL


You develop AI applications to address various business challenges, including virtual assistants to enhance client experiences, advanced AI tools to support employee efficiency and creativity, and automation to optimize internal processes.
You use various analytical methods, including large language models (Prompt Engineering, RAG, Fine-tuning), speech-to-text, agentic AI applications, image generation and interpretation, and classical statistical/machine learning techniques. While expertise in all areas is not required, strong proficiency in core technologies and the ability to learn new methods as needed are essential.
You contribute to deploying AI applications in production using a comprehensive stack of tools.
You access one of the richest volumes of varied data in the market and apply your skills to it.
You evolve in an environment where innovation and lean processes are praised, straight-forward communication is encouraged, and peers understand the meaning of team up.
You work with a team of colleagues in an Agile organization who are ready to collaborate and to share their experience.


YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES


You hold at least a Master’s degree in a quantitative field like statistics, computer science or engineering, with a focus on natural language processing. A PhD is advantageous. Candidates from other academic backgrounds with strong analytics knowledge are also welcome.
You have a minimum of 3 years' experience in data science, preferably in the financial sector, though less experience may be accepted if your academic achievements are substantial.
You are fluent in English and have a good command of French and/or Dutch.
You are proficient in Python for model building and understand ML engineering fundamentals (e.g., versioning systems) to produce code ready for CI/CD integration.

We offer a wide range of training courses, workshops and webinars to choose from depending on your availability, interests and goals.

OUR OFFER

In addition to your remuneration and benefits (meal vouchers, insurance, holidays), we offer flexible salary options, allowing you to convert part of your salary into personalised benefits (phone use, IT equipment, transport, etc.).

OUR ENGAGEMENT

At BNP Paribas Fortis, we want to attract and retain all talent, whatever their gender, age, background or sexual orientation, and irrespective of whether they are living with a disability, as every person has their own experiences and their own identity. All of our full-time vacancies are also open to candidates wishing to work on an 80% or 90% full-time equivalent basis.

Title: Data Scientist–Agentic Bioinformatics
Description:
Bioinformatics & AI Expertise Unit

VIB–KU Leuven Center for Cancer Biology (CCB), Leuven, Belgium

The VIB–KU Leuven Center for Cancer Biology (CCB) is a leading research institute focused on understanding cancer biology and developing innovative therapies. Our Bioinformatics & AI Expertise Unit provides advanced computational support to multiple research groups within CCB (Learn more: Bioinformatics & AI).

We are seeking an Data Scientist with a background in bioinformatics or computational biology to explore, build, and deploy tools based on large language models (LLMs) that support research at CCB. This includes agentic workflows that help researchers find suitable methods, write and run analysis code, and work with multi‑omics and spatial data. You will critically evaluate these tools, bring the useful ones into daily use across research groups, and help the CCB community use them effectively and responsibly.

You will join a growing team led by Dr. Masoomeh Rahimpour and work closely with the Integrative Cancer Genomics lab of Prof. Jonas Demeulemeester, other CCB Expertise Units, and the ML Unit of VIB.AI, the VIB Center for AI & Computational Biology (Learn more: VIB.AI).

Key Responsibilities


Build LLM-based tools and agentic workflows for bioinformatics tasks, such as assistants that help run and document standard analyses, retrieval over internal protocols and documentation.
Connect LLM tools to existing bioinformatics resources, including our pipelines, HPC environment, databases, and public resources (e.g., via tool calling or MCP).
Evaluate the reliability of these tools on realistic research tasks, with attention to correctness, reproducibility, and data privacy.
Deploy and maintain tools for CCB researchers in collaboration with the ML Unit at VIB.AI and the Vlaams Supercomputer Centrum (VSC).
Stay up to date with state‑of‑the‑art methods in LLMs, AI agents, and computational biology; evaluate, benchmark, and introduce relevant tools and best practices.
Deliver training and workshops on the practical and responsible use of LLMs and AI tools in research.


Profile

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and career paths. If this role interests you and you meet most of the essential requirements, we encourage you to apply.


A PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, or a related field or equivalent professional experience (e.g. in industry).
Strong programming skills in Python.
Hands-on experience with LLMs (via APIs or open-weight models), for example prompt design, or tool/function calling.
Working knowledge of common bioinformatic workflows (e.g. sequencing, single-cell, or spatial data), enough to judge whether an AI-generated analysis makes sense.
Ability to explain AI concepts and their limitations clearly to non-specialists.
Willingness to keep learning and to share knowledge with colleagues.
Good communication skills in English.


Nice To Have


Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over scientific literature or internal documentation.
Experience with agent frameworks (e.g. LangGraph or similar).
Experience running open-weight models on local or HPC hardware.


What We Offer


Access to unique datasets and cutting-edge infrastructure.
A collaborative and international research environment.
Support for your personal and professional development through training, mentoring, and career development.
A salary in line with VIB salary scales, based on your experience, and a benefit package.
A full-time, indefinite contract with flexible working hours.


How to Apply

Please complete the application through the CCB online application tool. Your application should include:


A motivation letter explaining your interest in the role and how your experience relates to it.
Your CV.
Contact information of three references (we only contact references of shortlisted candidates).


Application deadline: 30 November 2026

For inquiries, contact masoomeh.rahimpour@kuleuven.be with subject line: Data Scientist - Agentic Bioinformatics
